  9. 5.1.9 Abhyaas: Process lagao

5.1.1 Processes aur patterns

  • Process = sochne ka tareeka, kisi bhi position mein: forcing moves (checks, captures, threats) dekhna, calculation (aage ki chaalein sochna), visualization (dimaag mein board), evaluation (line ke end mein kaun behtar: material, king safety, pawn structure).
  • Pattern = jaani-pehchaani shakal: fork, pin, deflection, mate patterns.
  • Pattern pata na ho tab bhi process se jeet sakte ho.
  • Aur patterns process ko tez karte hain.

5.1.2 Chess ek-chaal ka game hai

  • Har chaal mein opponent sirf ek kaam kar sakta hai.
  • Agar tum ek chaal se do threats banao, aur koi ek chaal dono ko na roke, to ek cheez jaayegi.
  • Isliye double attack (fork) sabse important tactic hai.
  • Kabhi double attack ek piece nahi karta: ek piece hatne se peeche wale ka attack khulta hai (discovered attack).

5.1.3 Sawal 1: Opponent ki do cheezon par ek saath threat hai, aur koi ek chaal…

Opponent ki do cheezon par ek saath threat hai, aur koi ek chaal dono nahi bachati. Kyun jeet hoti hai?

Jawab

✓ Kyunki chess mein ek turn mein ek hi chaal hoti hai

  • Single-turn game: ek chaal = ek bachaav.

5.1.4 Downsides ka jashn: unprotected pieces aur king

  • Position dekh kar pehle opponent ki kamzoriyan (downsides) dhundo:
    • Unprotected pieces: sabse classic downside. Kabhi seedha nahi pakad sakte, use doosre downside (jaise check) mein badalna padta hai.
    • King safety: khula king, kamzor back rank, pawns aage badhe hue.
  • Calculation in downsides ko ubhaarne ka tool hai.
  • Pata ho ki kya dhundh rahe ho, to aur aage tak dekh paate ho.

5.1.5 Defensive hero ko hatao

  • Calculation ek draft story jaisi hai.
  • Aksar story mein ek defensive hero hota hai: woh ek piece jo tumhara plan bigaad deta hai (mate square bachata hai, piece ko protect karta hai).
  • Story dobara likho: pehle hero ko capture karo, bhagao, ya bhatkao (removing the defender, deflection), phir plan chalao.

5.1.6 Sawal 2: Tumhari mate ki line mein ek black knight f6 square h7 ko bacha…

Tumhari mate ki line mein ek black knight f6 square h7 ko bacha raha hai. Pehle kya socho?

Jawab

✓ Knight (defensive hero) ko kaise hatayein

  • Defender hatao, phir mate.

5.1.7 Facts awareness

  • Har forcing chaal khelni zaroori nahi: kabhi quiet chaal (jo badi threat banaye) zyada strong.
  • Opponent ki threat aur trap se jaagruk raho, par darr ke ruk mat jao: kabhi aur aage calculate karo to dikhega ki "khatra" asli nahi.

5.1.8 Abhyaas: Process lagao

Process lagao: pehle saare checks, captures, threats dekho. Best chaal?

Jawab dekho

1. Qe6+ Kf8 2. Qxb6

  • Qe6+ Kf8 Qxb6: Forcing chaalon ki list banane se yeh mila.

5.1.9 Abhyaas: Process lagao

Process lagao: pehle saare checks, captures, threats dekho. Best chaal?

Jawab dekho

1. hxg5 Ng4 2. Nxg4

  • hxg5 Ng4 Nxg4: Forcing chaalon ki list banane se yeh mila.

5.2

Fork (do pe ek saath attack)

Knight, queen aur pawn forks

Yaad rakho
  • Fork = ek piece se do ya zyada pieces par ek saath attack.
  • Knight fork sabse khatarnaak: uska attack block nahi hota.
  • Best fork = check + kuch aur: pehle king bachana padta hai.
  • Pawn aur queen bhi fork karte hain. Royal fork = king + queen.
  • Fork = double attack. King + kuch aur par fork sabse strong (check ka jawab dena padta hai).
  • Pawn bhi fork karta hai. Fork se pawn ko promote karne ka raasta bhi ban sakta hai.
  • Famous: Petrosian-Spassky, Petrosian-Simagin, Botvinnik-Kotov, Anand-Kasparov, Tal-Pliss (pawn fork).

5.2.1 Fork kya hai

  • Fork = ek piece se do ya zyada dushman pieces par ek saath attack.
  • Opponent ek hi bacha sakta hai.
  • Knight fork sabse khatarnaak hota hai kyunki knight ka attack block nahi hota.
  • Sabse best fork: king + kuch aur (check ke saath), kyunki check pehle bachana padta hai.

5.2.6 Masters ke forks

  • Fork har level par aata hai:
    • Petrosian vs Spassky, Petrosian vs Simagin, Botvinnik vs Kotov: knight aur queen ke forks se material.
    • Avrukh vs Kamsky: fork se pawn ko queen banane ka raasta saaf.
    • Aronian vs Seel, Anand vs Kasparov, Keene vs Botvinnik.
    • Tal vs Pliss: "pawns bhi fork karte hain!"
  • Ab khud karo: aur forks.

5.3

Pin

Piece hil nahi sakta

Yaad rakho
  • Pin: aage wala piece hil nahi sakta kyunki peeche zyada keemti piece hai.
  • Absolute pin (peeche king): kanoonan hil nahi sakta. Relative pin (peeche queen/rook): hilega to nuksaan.
  • Pinned piece par aur attack karo (aksar pawn se).
  • Bishop, rook, queen hi pin karte hain.
  • Absolute pin: peeche king, pinned piece chal hi nahi sakta. Relative pin: peeche queen/rook, chal sakta hai par nuksaan.
  • Relative pin kabhi tod sakte ho (rebel) agar badle mein bada fayda ho (Legal trap, Popov-Petkovski).
  • Pinned piece defender nahi raha: pin se mate ya material jeeto (Nimzowitsch-Rubinstein).

  2. 5.3.2 Abhyaas: Pin karke queen jeeto

  5. 5.3.5 Pin ke prakaar

  7. 5.3.7 Sawal 2: Pinned piece ke peeche king hai

5.3.1 Pin kya hai

  • Pin = ek piece hil nahi sakta (ya hilna nahi chahiye) kyunki uske peeche zyada keemti piece hai.
  • Absolute pin: peeche king hai. Pinned piece kanoonan hil hi nahi sakta.
  • Relative pin: peeche queen/rook hai. Hil sakta hai par nuksaan hoga.
  • Pin ka fayda: pinned piece par aur attack karo (jaise pawn se).

5.3.2 Abhyaas: Pin karke queen jeeto

Pin karke queen jeeto.

Jawab dekho

1. Bd4

  • Bd4! queen h8 king ke saath pin hai.
  • Woh hat nahi sakti: Qxd4 cxd4 ke baad Black ne queen (9) dekar bishop (3) liya.

5.3.3 Abhyaas: Pinned knight par attack karo!

Pinned knight par attack karo!

Jawab dekho

1. d5

  • d5! knight pinned hai (peeche king).
  • Woh bhaag nahi sakta, agli chaal dxc6 se piece jeet.

5.3.4 Sawal 1: Yahan c6 ka knight kis type ke pin mein hai?

Yahan c6 ka knight kis type ke pin mein hai?

Jawab

✓ Absolute pin (peeche king)

  • Bb5 se e8 king tak diagonal: knight beech mein hai aur kanoonan hil nahi sakta.

5.3.5 Pin ke prakaar

  • Absolute pin: peeche king. Pinned piece chal hi nahi sakta (illegal).
  • Relative pin: peeche queen ya rook. Chal sakta hai, par peeche wala jaayega.
  • Relative pin se bagawat: kabhi pinned piece chala do agar badle mein mate ya bada fayda ho (Legal trap mein Nxe5!, Popov vs Petkovski).
  • Pin ka jashn: pinned piece "nakli defender" hai. Us par aur attackers lao (Nimzowitsch vs Rubinstein: pin se mate force).
  • Examples: Nimzowitsch-Nielsen (defensive hero ko pin karke hataaya), Bronstein-Goldenov (pin se key square par kabza), Xie Jun-Yu Lefu.

5.3.6 Elephant trap (Queen's Gambit Declined): pin jo pin nahi tha

  • White ko laga f6 knight pinned hai aur d5 pawn free hai.
  • Par Black ka jawab tayyar tha.

1. d4 d5 2. c4 e6 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. Bg5 Nbd7 5. cxd5 exd5 6. Nxd5 Nxd5 7. Bxd8 Bb4+ 8. Qd2 Bxd2+ 9. Kxd2 Kxd8

  • 4...Nbd7 trap set.
  • 6.Nxd5?? "knight pinned hai" soch kar pawn liya.
  • 6...Nxd5! relative pin todi! Queen de di.
  • 7.Bxd8
  • 7...Bb4+! check.
  • 8.Qd2 sirf yahi.
  • 8...Bxd2+
  • 9...Kxd8 Black ek piece aage.

5.3.7 Sawal 2: Pinned piece ke peeche king hai

Pinned piece ke peeche king hai. Kya woh chal sakta hai?

Jawab

✓ Nahi, illegal hai

  • Absolute pin.

5.4

Skewer

Ulta pin

Yaad rakho
  • Skewer = ulta pin: keemti piece aage (aksar king), kam keemti peeche.
  • Aage wala hatega, peeche wala capture.
  • Line pieces (rook, bishop, queen) hi skewer karte hain.
  • Skewer = ulta pin: aage bada piece (king/queen), hatega to peeche wala jaayega.
  • Famous: Short-Vaganian, Kasparov-Tatai, Fischer-Stepans, Carlsen-Anand, Kramnik-Nakamura.

5.4.1 Skewer

  • Skewer pin ka ulta hai: keemti piece aage hai (aksar king), aur kam keemti peeche.
  • Aage wala hatega, to peeche wala capture.
  • Rooks, bishops aur queens skewer karte hain (seedhi line wale pieces).

  • Woh hatta hai, peeche wala jaata hai.
  • Aksar check ke saath.
  • Examples: Short-Vaganian, Kasparov-Tatai, Fischer-Stepans, Unzicker-Tal, Carlsen-Anand, Spassky-Korchnoi, Kramnik-Nakamura, Rivera-Fischer.

5.5

Discovered attack aur double check

Chhupa hua attack

Yaad rakho
  • Discovered attack: aage wala piece hate to peeche wale ka attack khul jaata hai.
  • Hatne wala piece bhi kuch attack kare = do threats ek saath.
  • Double check ka jawab sirf king ko hatana hai: block ya capture nahi.
  • Discovered attack: aage wala piece hat-ta hai aur khud bhi kuch attack karta hai = do threats.
  • Discovered check sabse khatarnak: aage wala piece kuch bhi le sakta hai.
  • Famous: Reti-Tartakower, Bronstein-Geller, Fischer-Spassky 1972 (game 8), Kasparov-Karpov.

  2. 5.5.2 Abhyaas: Discovered check se queen jeeto

5.5.1 Discovered attack

  • Jab ek piece hatta hai aur uske peeche wale piece ka attack khul jaata hai, use discovered attack kehte hain.
  • Agar khula attack king par ho to discovered check.
  • Khatarnaak kyunki hatne wala piece bhi kuch attack kar sakta hai: do threats ek saath!
  • Double check: dono pieces check dein.
  • Iska jawab sirf king ko hatana hai.

  • King ke saare squares band, aur double check block ya capture nahi hota.

5.5.4 Masters ke discovered attacks

  • Examples: Reti-Tartakower (queen sacrifice ke baad discovered double check), Bronstein-Geller, Fischer-Spassky 1972 (game 8), Kasparov-Karpov, Reti-Bogoljubov, Petrosian-Matanovic.
  • Yaad rakho: jo piece hat-ta hai, use bhi kaam do (capture, check ya threat).

5.6

Defender hatao aur overloading

Removing the defender (undermining), overloaded piece

Yaad rakho
  • Removing the defender: bachaane wale piece ko capture karo ya bhagao.
  • Deflection: defender ko zabardasti door le jao.
  • Overloading: ek defender ke do kaam, ek par vaar karo.
  • Decoy: dushman piece ko kharab square par lalchao.
  • Removing the defender (undermining / removing the guard): defender ko capture karo ya bhagao.
  • Overloading: ek piece ke paas do kaam; ek kaam par hamla karo, doosra chhoot jaayega.
  • Examples: Tseshkovsky-Kasparov, Karjakin-Short, Adams-Whiteley, Uhlmann-Schwartz.

  • Overloading: ek defender ke paas do kaam hain. Ek kaam par attack karo, doosra khul jaayega.

Middlegame 2: Advanced tactics aur calculation

Deflection, decoy, interference, clearance, x-ray, zwischenzug, golden rules, calculation

6.1

Deflection aur decoy

Defender ko door bhagao, ya dushman piece ko kharab square par kheencho

Yaad rakho
  • Deflection: defender ko uski duty se door kheencho (aksar sacrifice se).
  • Decoy: dushman piece (aksar king/queen) ko kisi kharab square par laao, phir fork/skewer/mate.
  • Famous deflection: Timman-Yusupov, Zukertort-Blackburne, Velimirovic-Csom, Botvinnik-Keres, Tal-Averbakh.
  • Famous decoy: Bjornsson-Tal, Nimzowitsch-Mieses, Seirawan-Polgar, Letelier-Fischer, Korchnoi-Tal, Polgar-Hansen.

  • Deflection = defender ko uske kaam se door le jao.
  • Jaise ek rook back rank bacha raha hai: use kisi aur cheez par capture karne pe majboor karo, phir back rank par mate.
  • Examples: Timman-Yusupov, Chandler-Gruenfeld, Zukertort-Blackburne, Velimirovic-Csom, Canal vs NN, Botvinnik-Keres, Chiburdanidze-Malaniuk, Tal-Averbakh, Lputian-Balashov.

6.2

Interference, clearance, x-ray, zwischenzug

Lines kaatna aur kholna, aar-paar attack, beech ki chaal

Yaad rakho
  • Zwischenzug: recapture se pehle ek zyada forcing chaal.
  • X-ray: piece dushman piece ke aar-paar square control karta hai.
  • Interference: do dushman pieces ke beech apna piece rakh kar connection kaato.
  • Clearance, desperado, perpetual check: ye bhi yaad rakho.
  • Interference (disconnection, "spanner"): do dushman pieces ke beech apna piece rakh kar unka connection kaato.
  • Clearance (line clearance): apna hi piece raaste se hatao (aksar tempo ke saath) taaki doosre piece ki line khule.
  • X-ray: piece doosre piece ke aar-paar square ko control/support karta hai.
  • Zwischenzug: expected recapture se pehle ek zyada forcing chaal.

  11. 6.2.11 Diagram: X-ray: Rd1 ka attack apne Rd2 ke aar-paar d8 tak (doubling)

6.2.1 Advanced motifs

  • Zwischenzug (in-between move): expected recapture ki jagah pehle ek zyada forcing chaal (check/threat) khelo.
  • X-ray: piece dushman piece ke aar-paar ek square ko control karta hai.
  • Interference: do dushman pieces ke beech mein apna piece rakh kar unka connection kaato.
  • Clearance: apne hi piece ko hata kar line/square khaali karo.
  • Desperado: jo piece waise bhi jaane wala hai, use jitna ho sake mehenga becho.
  • Perpetual check: haarti position mein lagaataar check de kar draw.

6.2.2 Sawal 1: Opponent ne tumhara knight capture kiya

Opponent ne tumhara knight capture kiya. Recapture ki jagah tum pehle check dete ho jo queen ko bhi attack karta hai. Yeh kya kehlata hai?

Jawab

✓ Zwischenzug

  • In-between move: pehle bada threat, recapture baad mein.

6.2.3 Sawal 2: Tum haar rahe ho, par opponent ke king ko lagaataar check de sakte ho

Tum haar rahe ho, par opponent ke king ko lagaataar check de sakte ho. Kya milega?

Jawab

✓ Draw (perpetual check / repetition)

  • Lagaataar checks se same position repeat hoti hai = draw.

6.2.4 Interference (spanner in the works)

  • Do dushman pieces ek doosre ko support kar rahe hain (jaise do rooks, ya rook jo mate square bachata hai).
  • Unke beech mein apna piece rakho: ab line kat gayi.
  • Use capture karne mein bhi line aksar band rehti hai.
  • Examples: Miles-Pritchett, Piket-Kramnik, Kramnik-Topalov, Koskinen-Kasman, Karpov-Polgar.

6.2.5 Sawal 3: Black ka rook b8 aur queen g8 ek doosre ko back rank par bachate hain

Black ka rook b8 aur queen g8 ek doosre ko back rank par bachate hain. Tum e8 par piece rakh do jo dono line kaat de. Yeh kaunsa tactic?

Jawab

✓ Interference

  • Line ke beech piece rakhna = interference.

6.2.6 Clearance (line kholna)

  • Kabhi apna hi piece raasta rok raha hota hai.
  • Use tempo ke saath (check, capture ya threat se) hatao taaki queen/rook/bishop ki line khul jaaye, ya square khaali ho jaaye.
  • Examples: Keene-Briant, Karjakin-Komiliakov, La Bourdonnais-McDonnell.

6.2.7 Sawal 4: Tumhari queen ki h-file par tumhara apna knight h5 baitha hai

Tumhari queen ki h-file par tumhara apna knight h5 baitha hai. Knight check dekar hatta hai aur queen h7 par mate karti hai. Yeh kya hai?

Jawab

✓ Clearance

  • Apna piece hata kar line kholna = clearance.

6.2.8 X-ray

  • Piece doosre piece ke aar-paar dekhta hai.
  • Jaise rook queen ke peeche ho (battery): queen trade hone par rook usi square ko support karta hai.
  • Examples: Fischer-Bisguier, Euwe-Loman, Ivanchuk-Van Wely, Mamedyarov-Carlsen.

6.2.9 Abhyaas: X-ray: queens aamne-saamne, dono ke peeche rooks

X-ray: queens aamne-saamne, dono ke peeche rooks. Kaun jeetega? Chaal chalo.

Jawab dekho

1. Qxd6 Rxd6 2. Rxd6

  • Qxd6 Rxd6 Rxd6.
  • d1 rook ne queen ke aar-paar d6 ko support kiya.
  • White ek rook aage.

6.2.10 Abhyaas: Zwischenzug!

Zwischenzug! Black ne tumhari queen d2 par le li. Recapture se pehle ek zyada forcing chaal?

Jawab dekho

1. Rxe8+ Kh7 2. Nxd2

  • Pehle Rxe8+ (check ke saath rook), phir Nxd2 se queen wapas.
  • Seedha Nxd2?? par Rxe1+ aur tum peeche.

6.3

Calculation ke 3 golden rules

Pichli chaal ki kamzori, killer common squares, in-effect clause, squares ka pyaar

Yaad rakho
  • Rule 1: Opponent ki pichli chaal ne kya kamzor chhoda? (square, piece, line)
  • Rule 2: Killer common squares: jahan tumhare do pieces mil kar attack karte hain, wahan sacrifice ya mate aksar kaam karta hai.
  • Rule 3: In-effect clause: har chaal ka poore board par asar dekho (discovered lines, khule raaste, open/closed position).
  • Teeno ka raaz ek: chess squares ka khel hai. Jeetne ke liye key squares tak pahuncho.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 6.3.1 Calculation kya hai?
  2. 6.3.2 Rule 1: Pichli chaal ki kamzori
  3. 6.3.3 Rule 2: Killer common squares
  4. 6.3.4 Abhyaas: Common square dhundo jahan tumhare pieces mil kar mate karein
  5. 6.3.5 Abhyaas: Common square dhundo jahan tumhare pieces mil kar mate karein
  6. 6.3.6 Abhyaas: Common square dhundo jahan tumhare pieces mil kar mate karein
  7. 6.3.7 Abhyaas: Common square dhundo jahan tumhare pieces mil kar mate karein
  8. 6.3.8 Rule 3: In-effect clause
  9. 6.3.9 Abhyaas: In-effect clause
  10. 6.3.10 Abhyaas: In-effect clause
  11. 6.3.11 Abhyaas: In-effect clause
  12. 6.3.12 Squares ka pyaar
  13. 6.3.13 Sawal 1: Teeno golden rules mein common cheez kya hai?

6.3.1 Calculation kya hai?

  • Calculation = aage ki chaalein dimaag mein khelna: meri chaal, opponent ka sabse achha jawab, phir meri... aur end mein evaluate karna.
  • Forcing moves se shuru karo kyunki unke jawab kam hote hain.
  • Is course ke teen golden rules calculation ko asaan banate hain.

6.3.2 Rule 1: Pichli chaal ki kamzori

  • Har chaal kuch naya kholti hai aur kuch chhodti hai.
  • Opponent ke chalne ke baad pucho:
    • Is piece ne kaunsa square/piece bachana chhod diya?
    • Kaunsi line khul gayi?
    • Kya koi piece ab unprotected hai?

6.3.3 Rule 2: Killer common squares

  • Woh squares jahan tumhare do (ya zyada) pieces ek saath pahunchte hain.
  • Wahan:
    • sacrifice karke bhi recapture ho jaata hai,
    • ek piece doosre ko support karke mate deta hai (jaise queen + bishop h7 par).
  • Kabhi common square shuru se hota hai, kabhi calculation ke beech banta hai.
  • Dovetail aur Mayet jaise mate patterns isi par chalte hain.

  • Line: Qxc6+ Kd8 Qc7#.
  • Do pieces ek hi square/area par mile: wahi killer common square.

6.3.8 Rule 3: In-effect clause

  • Sirf jo piece chala uske arrows mat dekho.
  • Poore board par asar dekho:
    • Hatne se kaunsi line khuli (discovered effects)?
    • Kaunse doosre pieces azaad hue?
    • Pawns ka role: open position (khule raaste) mein tactics zyada, closed mein kam.

In-effect clause: chaal ka poore board par asar dekho.

6.3.12 Squares ka pyaar

  • Teeno rules ek hi baat kehte hain: chess squares ka khel hai.
  • Pichli chaal ki kamzori = neglected squares, common squares = cooperation wale squares, in-effect = naye khule squares.
  • Spassky ne Fischer ke against 1972 mein ek ajeeb chaal se key squares jeete.

Calculation aur visualization

Dimaag mein board dekhna

Yaad rakho
  • 2-4 candidate moves chuno (pehle CCT).

6.5

Calculation 2: skip rules aur 2 chaal

Kaunsi line chhodni hai, opponent ka forcing jawab, 2 chaal ki line

Yaad rakho
  • Pehle forcing chaalein. Quiet chaal tabhi jab forcing se kuch na mile.
  • Jo chaal bina check/mate ke apna piece latka de, use chhodo.
  • Opponent ke jawab: pehle uske checks aur captures, phir 1 best defence.
  • Har line ek baar socho, nateeja yaad rakho (+3, barabar, mate).
  • Ek line saaf jeet de to baaki chhodo: simple jeet best.
  • Position shaant ho gayi to ruko.

  1. 6.5.1 Tez calculation ka raaz: kya NAHI sochna

6.5.1 Tez calculation ka raaz: kya NAHI sochna

  • Grandmaster zyada lines nahi sochte.
  • Woh faltu lines jaldi chhod dete hain.
  • Yeh 6 skip rules yaad karo:
  • 1.
  • Pehle forcing chaalein (check, capture, threat).
  • Quiet chaal tabhi jab forcing se kuch na mile.
  • 2.
  • Jo chaal bina check ya mate ke apna piece latka de, use chhod do.
  • 3.
  • Opponent ke jawab mein pehle uske checks aur captures, phir 1 best defence.
  • Baaki jawab chhodo.
  • 4.
  • Har line ek hi baar socho, end mein nateeja yaad rakho.
  • Dobara mat socho.
  • 5.
  • Ek candidate saaf jeet de raha ho to baaki chhodo.
  • 6.
  • Position shaant ho gayi (koi check, capture, threat nahi) to wahin ruko.

6.5.2 Sawal 1: Tumhari candidate chaal se tumhara rook latak jaata hai, aur woh…

Tumhari candidate chaal se tumhara rook latak jaata hai, aur woh check bhi nahi hai. Kya karein?

Jawab

✓ Is line ko chhod do (skip rule 2)

  • Bina forcing wajah ke piece latkana = line chhodo.
  • Time bacha, dusre candidates par lagao.

6.5.3 Sawal 2: Tumne check diya

Tumne check diya. Opponent ke 3 jawab hain: king hatana, piece beech mein rakhna, ya checking piece ko capture karna. Pehle kaunsa socho?

Jawab

✓ Capture (sabse forcing)

  • Opponent ke liye bhi forcing pehle: capture sabse khatarnak jawab hota hai.
  • Phir block, phir king move.

6.5.4 Sawal 3: Ek line mein tum queen jeet rahe ho aur position shaant hai

Ek line mein tum queen jeet rahe ho aur position shaant hai. Kya aur candidates sochne chahiye?

Jawab

✓ Nahi, blunder check karo aur chalo

  • Skip rule 5: saaf jeet mil gayi to bas.
  • Sirf blunder check.

6.5.5 2 chaal ki line kaise sochte hain

  • 2 chaal = meri chaal → uska jawab → meri chaal.
  • Candidate chuno (CCT).
  • Opponent ka sabse forcing jawab socho. Check ke baad aksar uske 1-2 hi jawab hote hain.
  • Har jawab ke baad apni doosri chaal dhundo, aur nateeja gino.
  • Check se shuru hone wali lines sabse tez calculate hoti hain, kyunki opponent ke paas kam options hote hain.

6.5.6 Abhyaas: 2 chaal mein mate

2 chaal mein mate. Check se shuru karo, phir opponent ka jawab socho.

Jawab dekho

1. Ne7+ Kh8 2. Rf8#

  • Ne7+ Kh8 Rf8#: check ke baad king ke paas sirf h8 tha, aur phir back-rank mate.
  • Lichess puzzle [116xS] · rating 852

6.5.7 Abhyaas: 2 chaal: check se fork

2 chaal: check se fork. Opponent ka forced jawab socho.

Jawab dekho

1… Nf3+ 2. Kg2 Nxd4

  • Nf3+: check + queen par attack (fork).
  • King hatega, phir Nxd4.
  • Lichess puzzle [567t5] · rating 900

6.5.8 Abhyaas: 2 chaal: opponent ke capture wale jawab ko bhi socho

2 chaal: opponent ke capture wale jawab ko bhi socho.

Jawab dekho

1. Ne7+ Rxe7 2. Qxe7

  • Ne7+: king aur queen par fork.
  • Rxe7 ke baad Qxe7 se rook bhi gaya.
  • Opponent ka capture wala jawab pehle socha, isliye line pakki thi.
  • Lichess puzzle [g4zB5] · rating 902

6.6

Calculation 3: 3-5 chaal ka tree

Candidate tree, checkpoints, board ko dimaag mein rakhna

Yaad rakho
  • Tree: 2-3 candidates, har ek par opponent ke 1-2 forcing jawab.
  • Har 2 chaal par checkpoint: material, king, latke pieces.
  • Hata hua piece dimaag se bhi hatao. Naya khula raasta (file, diagonal) yaad rakho.
  • Lambi line sirf forcing chaalon mein. Quiet position mein 2-3 chaal + evaluation.
  • Line ke end mein sawal: kya opponent ke paas koi check bacha?
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 6.6.1 Calculation tree
  2. 6.6.2 Board ko dimaag mein kaise rakhein
  3. 6.6.3 Sawal 1: Line mein tumhara bishop capture ho gaya
  4. 6.6.4 Sawal 2: Position shaant hai, koi check ya capture nahi
  5. 6.6.5 Abhyaas: 3 chaal: check, check, phir jeet
  6. 6.6.6 Abhyaas: 3 chaal: pehle sacrifice, phir fork
  7. 6.6.7 Abhyaas: 4 chaal mein mate

6.6.1 Calculation tree

  • 3-5 chaal mein lines ped (tree) ki tarah failti hain.
  • Ped ko chhota rakho:
    • Jad: 2-3 candidates (CCT).
    • Shaakhaayein: har candidate par opponent ke 1-2 forcing jawab.
    • Har shaakha ko ek baar end tak le jao, nateeja likho (dimaag mein): +3, =, mate.
    • Sabse achhe nateeje wali jad chuno.
  • Agar 3 candidates × 2 jawab × 2 = 12 lines ho rahi hain to skip rules lagao.
  • Aksar 3-4 lines hi asli hoti hain.

6.6.2 Board ko dimaag mein kaise rakhein

  • Lambi calculation mein galti aksar visualization ki hoti hai, chess ki nahi:
    • Ghost piece: jo piece capture ho gaya, dimaag mein woh ab bhi "bacha raha" lagta hai. Har capture par bolo: "ab yeh piece nahi hai".
    • Naye raaste: piece hata to uske peeche ki file ya diagonal khul gayi. Bolo: "ab d-file khuli".
    • Checkpoint: har 2 chaal par ruk kar 3 cheezein gino: material, dono kings, latke hue pieces.
  • Gym ke Andhe steps yahi sikhate hain: position dekho, yaad karo, phir khali board par chalo.

Line mein tumhara bishop capture ho gaya. Ab calculation mein sabse badi galti kya hogi?

Jawab

✓ Yeh maan lena ki bishop ab bhi e5 ko bacha raha hai

  • Ghost piece ki galti.
  • Har capture ke baad dimaag ki tasveer update karo.

6.6.4 Sawal 2: Position shaant hai, koi check ya capture nahi

Position shaant hai, koi check ya capture nahi. Kitna gehra calculate karein?

Jawab

✓ 2-3 chaal aur phir evaluation

  • Lambi lines sirf forcing sequences mein.
  • Quiet position mein chhoti calculation + plan + evaluation.

6.6.5 Abhyaas: 3 chaal: check, check, phir jeet

3 chaal: check, check, phir jeet. Har check ke baad opponent ke saare jawab socho.

Jawab dekho

1. Qf3+ Kg8 2. Re8+ Rxe8 3. Qxd5+

  • Rxe8 Qxd5+`: rook dekar Black ki queen jeet li.
  • Do checks ne opponent ke options band rakhe.
  • Lichess puzzle [djn3j] · rating 1250

  • Rxf1+ Kxf1 Ng3+ king aur queen par fork, phir Nxh5.
  • Rook gaya, queen mili.

Level 7

Middlegame 3: Checkmate patterns

Mate ki kala, back-rank, smothered, aur 25+ famous mate patterns

  • Mate patterns tactics ke "shortcut" hain: shakal pehchaan li to calculation turant ho jaati hai.
  • Har pattern ka naam, idea aur practice.
7.1

Mate patterns: shuruaat aur mate ki kala

Escape squares band karo, quiet moves, famous patterns

Yaad rakho
  • Strong players mate pattern pehchante hain, har baar calculate nahi karte.
  • Back-rank, smothered, Anastasia, Arabian, Boden: shakal yaad karo.
  • Legal's mate: pinned knight se queen sacrifice, teen minor pieces se mate.
  • Greek gift Bxh7+: tab jab f6 par black knight na ho aur Ng5 safe ho.
  • Philidor's legacy: Qg8+!! Rxg8 Nf7# smothered mate.
  • Mate ki kala: pehle king ke escape squares band karo, phir check.
  • Kabhi quiet chaal (bina check) mate se pehle zaroori hoti hai.
  • Escape squares band ho gaye par check nahi to naya check dhundo.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 7.1.1 Patterns kyun?
  2. 7.1.2 Patterns = shortcuts
  3. 7.1.3 Abhyaas: Smothered mate in 1
  4. 7.1.4 Abhyaas: Anastasia mate in 1
  5. 7.1.5 Abhyaas: Arabian mate in 1
  6. 7.1.6 Abhyaas: Boden mate in 1
  7. 7.1.7 Abhyaas: Mate in 1
  8. 7.1.8 Abhyaas: Philidor's legacy (smothered mate)

  12. 7.1.12 Abhyaas: Mate in 2
  13. 7.1.13 Abhyaas: Mate in 2
  14. 7.1.14 Abhyaas: Mate in 2

7.1.1 Patterns kyun?

  • Checkmate pattern = pieces ki jaani-pehchaani shakal jo mate deti hai.
  • Pattern yaad ho to game mein dekhte hi pehchaan loge.
  • Mate ki kala:
  • 1.
  • King ke escape squares gino aur unhe ek-ek karke band karo.
  • 2.
  • Kabhi quiet chaal (check nahi) loud chaal se behtar: pehle jaal bichhao, phir check.
  • 3.
  • Saare escape squares band, par check nahi?
  • To naya check dhundo jo un squares ko band rakhe.

7.1.2 Patterns = shortcuts

  • Strong players har mate ko calculate nahi karte, woh pattern pehchante hain.
  • Yeh patterns yaad karo:
    • Back-rank mate: king apne pawns ke peeche band.
    • Smothered mate: king apne hi pieces se ghira, knight mate deta hai.
    • Anastasia mate: knight + rook, king kinare par.
    • Arabian mate: rook + knight corner mein.
    • Boden mate: do bishops criss-cross.
    • Legal mate: opening trap, queen sacrifice.
    • Greek gift: Bxh7+ sacrifice castled king par.

7.2

Back-rank mate

Apne hi pawns mein band king

Yaad rakho
  • King back rank par, aage apne pawns: rook ya queen ka check = mate.
  • Bachaav: "luft" (h3/h6 jaisi pawn chaal) se king ko saans do.
  • Defender ko hatao ya deflect karo, phir back rank par ghuso.
  • Famous: Carlsen-So, Bird-Zukertort, Averbakh-Ragozin, Polgar-Bareev, McShane-Mirumian, Bernstein-Capablanca.

7.2.1 Back-rank mate

  • King apni pehli (back) rank par hai aur aage apne hi pawns use rok rahe hain.
  • Rook ya queen ka back rank par check = mate.
  • Bachaav: waqt mile to h3/h6 jaisi chaal se king ko luft (saans) do.
  • Hamla: jo piece back rank bachata hai, use deflect ya overload karo.
  • Famous: Carlsen-So, Bird-Zukertort, Orbaan-Kramer, Averbakh-Ragozin (1954), Cooper-Ivanov, Shapiro-Silman, Polgar-Bareev, McShane-Mirumian, Davidovich-Aguado.

7.3

Smothered mate aur Philidor's legacy

Knight ka mate jab king apne pieces mein dab jaaye

Yaad rakho
  • Smothered mate: king ke saare squares apne pieces se bhare, knight check deta hai.
  • Philidor's legacy: queen check, knight checks, queen sacrifice g8 par, phir Nf7#.
  • Suffocation (semi-smothered) mate: knight + doosra piece, king apne pieces mein phansa.
  • Famous: McConnell-Morphy, Morphy vs NN (1856), Greco (1620), Morphy-Bryan (1859).

  6. 7.3.6 Sawal 1: Smothered mate kis piece se hota hai?

7.3.1 Smothered mate

  • King ke saare aas-paas ke squares apne hi pieces se bhare hain, aur knight check deta hai (knight ka check block nahi hota).
  • Sabse sundar mate!
  • Famous: McConnell-Morphy, Morphy vs NN (New Orleans 1856), NN-Greco (1620, 1625), Bird/Dobell vs NN, Bischoff-Mueller, Morphy-Bryan (1859), Hendriks-Welling.

  • King h8: g8 par rook, g7 h7 par pawns.
  • Knight check = mate.

  • Knight check deta hai, king ke kuch squares apne pieces se band, baaki kisi doosre piece (jaise bishop) se.
  • King "dam ghut-ne" se marta hai.

7.4

Rook aur knight/bishop ke mate patterns

Anastasia, Arabian, corner, Morphy, Pillsbury, Mayet, Opera, blind swine, Reti, hook, Vukovic

Yaad rakho
  • Anastasia: knight e7 + rook h-file, king h7.
  • Arabian: rook h7 + knight f6, king h8.
  • Corner: rook g-file + knight f7, king h8 (pawn h7).
  • Morphy: bishop long diagonal se check, rook g-file band.
  • Pillsbury: rook g-file se check, bishop h8 band karta hai.
  • Mayet: rook check, door se bishop support.
  • Opera: rook back rank par, bishop support (Morphy ka Opera game).
  • Blind swine: do rooks 7th rank par.
  • Reti: bishop + rook, king apne pieces mein (Reti-Tartakower).
  • Hook: rook + knight + pawn ek chain. Vukovic: rook + knight, king kinare par.

Queen, bishop aur pawn ke mate patterns

Damiano, Greco, Lolli, dovetail, swallow's tail, epaulette, Boden, Blackburne, double bishop, Max Lange, kill box, pawn mate

Level 8

Middlegame 4: Position aur pawn structure

Position ke elements, exchanges, pawn structure, weak squares, outposts

  • Jab koi tactic na ho, tab kya karein?
  • Pehle position ke elements aur pawn structure samjho: yahi plan ki neev hai.
8.1

Position ke elements aur exchanges

Material, time, space, king safety, pawn structure; kab trade karein

Yaad rakho
  • Material sab kuch nahi: time (development), space, king safety, pawn structure bhi ginti mein.
  • Jeet rahe ho (material aage): pieces trade karo, pawns nahi.
  • Haar rahe ho: pawns trade karo, pieces nahi (draw ke chances).
  • King par heavy attack: attacking pieces trade karo.
  • Tang (cramped) position: pieces trade karke saans lo, bure piece ko trade karo.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 8.1.1 Position ke 5 elements
  2. 8.1.2 Material sab kuch nahi: Ed. Lasker vs Thomas (1912)
  3. 8.1.3 Exchanges kab karein
  4. 8.1.4 Sawal 1: Tum ek rook aage ho
  5. 8.1.5 Sawal 2: Tum ek pawn peeche ho, endgame aa raha hai
  6. 8.1.6 Sawal 3: Opponent ki queen, rook aur knight tumhare king par attack kar…
  7. 8.1.7 Sawal 4: Tumhari position tang hai aur ek bishop apne pawns ke peeche band…

8.1.1 Position ke 5 elements

  • Sirf "accountant" ki tarah material mat gino.
  • Dekho:
  • 1.
  • Material (points)
  • 2.
  • Time (development, tempo)
  • 3.
  • Space (kitni jagah tumhare pieces ke paas)
  • 4.
  • King safety
  • 5.
  • Pawn structure
  • Ek element mein aage hokar doosre mein peeche ho sakte ho.
  • Jaise gambit: material kam, time zyada.

8.1.2 Material sab kuch nahi: Ed. Lasker vs Thomas (1912)

  • Queen sacrifice aur phir Black king ka poore board par shikaar!

1. d4 e6 2. Nf3 f5 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. Bg5 Be7 5. Bxf6 Bxf6 6. e4 fxe4 7. Nxe4 b6 8. Ne5 O-O 9. Bd3 Bb7 10. Qh5 Qe7 11. Qxh7+ Kxh7 12. Nxf6+ Kh6 13. Neg4+ Kg5 14. h4+ Kf4 15. g3+ Kf3 16. Be2+ Kg2 17. Rh2+ Kg1 18. Kd2#

  • 5.Bxf6 bishop dekar light squares par kabza.
  • 10.Qh5 attack.
  • 11.Qxh7+!! queen sacrifice.
  • 12.Nxf6+ double check!
  • 14.h4+ king ko aage kheencho.
  • 18.Kd2# king ki chaal se mate (O-O-O# bhi tha)!

8.1.3 Exchanges kab karein

  • Material aage: pieces trade karo, pawns nahi. Kam pieces = tumhara extra material zyada bhaari. (Benko vs Fischer)
  • Material peeche: pawns trade karo, pieces nahi. Kam pawns = draw ke chances (jaise sirf bishop bacha to mate nahi).
  • King par heavy attack: attacking pieces trade karo, attack khatam.
  • Tang (cramped) position: trade karke jagah banao, khaas kar apna bura piece trade karo.

Tum ek rook aage ho. Opponent queen trade offer karta hai. Kya karoge?

Jawab

✓ Trade karo: pieces kam = jeet aasaan

  • Aage ho to pieces trade.

  • Pawns kam honge to draw ke chances badhenge.

8.2

Pawn structure

Isolated, doubled, backward, passed, chains

Yaad rakho
  • Pawn moves permanent hain: structure decide karta hai pieces kahan achhe.
  • IQP: kamzor pawn, par active pieces. IQP wala attack kare, doosra trade kare.
  • Backward pawn ke aage ka square ek hole banta hai.
  • Pawn chain: base par attack karo (Nimzowitsch).
  • "Pawns chess ki aatma hain" (Philidor).
  • Pawns peeche nahi jaate: har pawn chaal ek pakka faisla. Socho kaunse squares hamesha ke liye kamzor honge.
  • Center ko pawns se bharna zaroori nahi: pieces se control bhi chalega (hypermodern, Reti vs Capablanca).
  • Pawn kamzor tab hota hai jab use pawn se bachaya na ja sake (dependency pieces par).
  • Pieces aur pawns ka harmony: bishop apne pawns ke opposite colour par.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 8.2.1 Pawns: chess ki aatma
  2. 8.2.2 Pawns = position ki haddi
  3. 8.2.3 Isolated pawn (IQP)
  4. 8.2.4 Doubled aur backward pawns
  5. 8.2.5 Pawn chain
  6. 8.2.6 Sawal 1: Isolated pawn ke saamne wala square kis kaam ka hai?
  7. 8.2.7 Sawal 2: Pawn chain par attack kahan karna chahiye?
  8. 8.2.8 Sawal 3: Tumhare center pawns light squares par hain
  9. 8.2.9 Sawal 4: Pawn chaal ko "irreversible" kyun kehte hain?

8.2.1 Pawns: chess ki aatma

  • "Pawns are the soul of chess" (Philidor).
  • Pawn structure (formation) batata hai ki pieces kahan jaayenge aur plan kya hoga.
  • Pawns peeche nahi jaate: har pawn chaal ek pakka faisla hai. Plaskett vs Adams aur Fischer vs Addison (probing strategy) mein galat pawn chaalon se hamesha ki kamzori bani.
  • Center bharna zaroori nahi: Reti vs Capablanca: pieces se door se center control (hypermodern).
  • Kamzor pawn = jise pawn se bachaya na ja sake, pieces par nirbhar.
  • Harmony: pieces aur pawns saath kaam karein. Bishop apne pawns ke opposite colour par. (Karjakin-Adams, Kasparov-Adams, Nimzowitsch-Capablanca)
  • Har structure ke upside aur downside hote hain: dono khelkar dekho.

8.2.2 Pawns = position ki haddi

  • "Pawns are the soul of chess" (Philidor).
  • Pawns peeche nahi jaate, isliye har pawn move permanent hai.
  • Pawn structure decide karta hai pieces kahan achhe honge.

8.2.3 Isolated pawn (IQP)

  • d4 pawn ke bagal (c, e files) mein koi apna pawn nahi: isolated.
  • Kamzori: pawn se protect nahi hota, aur uske aage d5 square blockade ke liye perfect (Black knight d5 par).
  • Taakat: active pieces, d5 break aur kingside attack.
  • IQP wala attack kare, doosra pieces trade karke endgame mein jaaye.

8.2.4 Doubled aur backward pawns

  • Backward pawn: bagal ke pawns aage nikal gaye, aur yeh aage nahi badh sakta kyunki aage ka square dushman control karta hai.
  • Yahan Black ka d6 backward hai aur d5 ek hole hai: White ke knight ke liye perfect ghar.
  • Doubled pawns (ek file par do): aksar kamzor, par open file deta hai.

8.2.5 Pawn chain

  • Pawn chain d4-e5 (White) aur e6-d5 (Black).
  • Rule (Nimzowitsch): chain ki base par attack karo.
  • Black ...c5 se d4 (base) par vaar karta hai.
  • White kingside par (f4-f5) attack karta hai, kyunki chain ka sira us taraf ishaara karta hai.

8.2.6 Sawal 1: Isolated pawn ke saamne wala square kis kaam ka hai?

Isolated pawn ke saamne wala square kis kaam ka hai?

Jawab

✓ Dushman ke knight ke liye blockade ghar

8.2.7 Sawal 2: Pawn chain par attack kahan karna chahiye?

Pawn chain par attack kahan karna chahiye?

Jawab

✓ Chain ki base par

8.2.8 Sawal 3: Tumhare center pawns light squares par hain

Tumhare center pawns light squares par hain. Kaunsa bishop "good" hai?

Jawab

✓ Dark-square bishop

  • Apne pawns ke opposite colour wala bishop free hota hai.

8.2.9 Sawal 4: Pawn chaal ko "irreversible" kyun kehte hain?

Pawn chaal ko "irreversible" kyun kehte hain?

Jawab

✓ Pawn peeche nahi jaata, jo square chhoda woh hamesha ke liye

  • Isliye pawn chaal soch-samajh kar.

8.3

Pawn structure: gehraai se

Pawn breaks, holes, minority attack, thorn pawn, passed, doubled, IQP, backward, hanging: upside aur downside

Yaad rakho
  • Pawn break (lever): pawn se dushman ki chain par chot karke lines kholna.
  • Hole: aisa square jise pawn kabhi control nahi kar sakta. Uske guard bishop ko trade karo.
  • Minority attack: kam pawns (jaise a+b) se zyada pawns (a+b+c) par hamla karke kamzori banana.
  • Thorn pawn: dushman king ke paas gehra ghusa pawn (f6/h6): mate ke mauke.
  • Har structure ke dono pehlu: doubled, IQP, backward, hanging pawns kamzor bhi, strong bhi.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 8.3.1 Pawn break aur hole
  2. 8.3.2 Minority attack
  3. 8.3.3 Sawal 1: Minority attack ka maksad?
  4. 8.3.4 Thorn pawn
  5. 8.3.5 Structures: upside aur downside
  6. 8.3.6 Sawal 2: Doubled pawns ka ek upside?

8.3.1 Pawn break aur hole

  • Pawn break (lever): apne pawn se dushman ke pawn par chot karke lines kholna. Jaise French mein ...c5, King's Indian mein ...f5.
  • Structural hole: aisa square jise koi pawn kabhi control nahi kar sakta (jaise d5 jab c aur e pawns aage chale gaye). Agar us square ka guard ek bishop hai, use trade karo: hole tumhara.

8.3.2 Minority attack

  • Queen's Gambit Exchange structure: White ke 2 pawns (a, b) Black ke 3 pawns (a, b, c) par chadhte hain: b4-b5.
  • Trade ke baad Black ke paas kamzor c-pawn (backward/isolated) bachta hai.

8.3.3 Sawal 1: Minority attack ka maksad?

Minority attack ka maksad?

Jawab

✓ Dushman ke structure mein kamzor pawn banana

  • Kamzor pawn = lambe samay ka target.

8.3.4 Thorn pawn

  • Dushman king ke paas gehra ghusa pawn, jaise f6 ya h6 (Black castled king ke against).
  • Yeh g7 jaise squares ko control karta hai aur mate ke patterns (Lolli) aasaan banata hai.
  • Jeet ke chances bahut badh jaate hain.
  • Examples: Lorenz-Orlov, Kramnik-Anand, Morales-Sanchez, Ivanovic-Popovic.

8.3.5 Structures: upside aur downside

  • Passed pawn: jeet ke chances, "pushed" hone chahiye. (Torre vs NN)
  • Doubled pawns: kamzor (ek doosre ko bacha nahi sakte), par open file aur center control de sakte hain. (Botvinnik vs Levenfish)
  • IQP (isolated queen's pawn): kamzor endgame mein, par middlegame mein activity aur attack.
  • Backward pawn: aage ka square hole ban jaata hai, par kabhi woh square aur pawn solid defense bhi.
  • Hanging pawns (c + d saath, bagal mein koi nahi): aage badhkar dabaav, par target bhi.

8.3.6 Sawal 2: Doubled pawns ka ek upside?

Doubled pawns ka ek upside?

Jawab

✓ Saath mein ek open/semi-open file milti hai

  • Capture se file khulti hai: rook ke liye.

8.4

Weak squares aur outposts

Pieces ke liye ghar

Yaad rakho
  • Outpost = jahan dushman pawn tumhare piece ko bhaga na sake.
  • Outpost par knight rook jitna strong ho sakta hai.
  • Bad bishop: apne hi pawns usi color par. Pawns bishop ke ulte color par rakho.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 8.4.1 Outpost
  2. 8.4.2 Good bishop vs bad bishop
  3. 8.4.3 Sawal 1: Knight ke liye sabse achha square?
  4. 8.4.4 Sawal 2: Outpost ki sabse zaroori shart kya hai?
  5. 8.4.5 Sawal 3: White ka bishop (c1) good hai ya bad?
  6. 8.4.6 Sawal 4: Knight ke liye sabse achha square kaunsa hai?

8.4.1 Outpost

  • Outpost: aisa square jahan tumhara piece baith sake aur koi dushman pawn use bhaga na sake, aur aksar apne pawn se protected ho.
  • d5 par knight: Black ke c aur e pawns use kabhi attack nahi kar sakte.
  • Aisa knight ek rook jitna strong ho sakta hai!
  • Weak square = jo pawns se protect na ho sake.
  • Pawn move karte waqt socho: kaunse squares kamzor ho rahe hain?

8.4.2 Good bishop vs bad bishop

  • White ke pawns light squares par hain (c4, d5, e4), aur bishop bhi light-square ka hai: woh apne hi pawns se ruka hai = bad bishop.
  • Rule: pawns ko apne bishop ke ulte color par rakho.
  • Bad bishop ko trade karo ya pawns ke bahar laao.

8.4.3 Sawal 1: Knight ke liye sabse achha square?

Knight ke liye sabse achha square?

Jawab

✓ Center mein outpost jahan pawn bhaga na sake

8.4.4 Sawal 2: Outpost ki sabse zaroori shart kya hai?

Outpost ki sabse zaroori shart kya hai?

Jawab

✓ Koi dushman pawn us piece ko bhaga na sake

  • Outpost = jahan dushman pawn kabhi attack na kar sake.
  • Upar se apna pawn protect kare to aur achha.

8.4.5 Sawal 3: White ka bishop (c1) good hai ya bad?

White ka bishop (c1) good hai ya bad?

Jawab

✓ Good bishop

  • White ke pawns light squares par hain, bishop dark squares ka hai: pawns raasta nahi rokte = good bishop.

8.4.6 Sawal 4: Knight ke liye sabse achha square kaunsa hai?

Knight ke liye sabse achha square kaunsa hai?

Jawab

✓ d5 (outpost, e4 se protected)

  • d5 par koi black pawn attack nahi kar sakta (c6/e6 pawn nahi) aur e4 pawn support karta hai.
  • "Knight on the rim is dim."

Level 9

Middlegame 5: Plans aur positional khel

Open files, 7th rank, plans, prophylaxis, positional sacrifices

  • Ab position ko plan mein badlo: rooks ko kaam do, plan banao, opponent ke plan roko, aur kabhi position ke liye material do.
9.1

Open files, 7th rank, piece activity

Rooks aur pieces ko zinda karo

Yaad rakho
  • Rooks ko open / half-open files par lao, phir 7th rank par ghuso.
  • Do rooks 7th par ("pigs on the 7th") aksar jeet.
  • Golden rule: sabse kharab piece ko behtar karo.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 9.1.1 Rooks ko kaam do
  2. 9.1.2 Sawal 1: Koi tactic nahi, koi threat nahi
  3. 9.1.3 Sawal 2: Rook ke liye sabse achhi file kaunsi hai?
  4. 9.1.4 Sawal 3: Rook 7th rank par itna strong kyun hota hai?
  5. 9.1.5 Sawal 4: Do rooks ek hi open file par (doubled rooks)
  6. 9.1.6 Diagram: Rook open file se 7th rank par ("pig on the 7th")

9.1.1 Rooks ko kaam do

  • Rooks ko open file (jisme koi pawn nahi) par lao, ya half-open file par.
  • File kabze ke baad 7th rank par ghuso: wahan pawns aur king dono atakte hain. Do rooks 7th par = "pigs on the 7th", aksar jeet.
  • Doubling: do rooks ek file par.
  • General rule: sabse kharab piece ko behtar karo.
  • Har position mein socho: mera kaunsa piece kuch nahi kar raha?

9.1.2 Sawal 1: Koi tactic nahi, koi threat nahi

Koi tactic nahi, koi threat nahi. Achha general plan?

Jawab

✓ Sabse kharab piece ko behtar square par lao

9.1.3 Sawal 2: Rook ke liye sabse achhi file kaunsi hai?

Rook ke liye sabse achhi file kaunsi hai?

Jawab

✓ d-file (koi pawn nahi = open)

  • Rook ko open file chahiye.
  • Wahan se woh 7th/8th rank tak ghus sakta hai.

9.1.4 Sawal 3: Rook 7th rank par itna strong kyun hota hai?

Rook 7th rank par itna strong kyun hota hai?

Jawab

✓ Wahan pawns aur king dono par dabaav hota hai

  • 7th rank par opponent ke pawns ghar par hote hain aur king 8th rank par fansta hai: "rook on the 7th" = double nishaana.

9.1.5 Sawal 4: Do rooks ek hi open file par (doubled rooks)

Do rooks ek hi open file par (doubled rooks). Fayda?

Jawab

✓ File par dabaav double, aur file ka kabza pakka

  • Doubled rooks file jeet lete hain.
  • Phir ek rook aage 7th rank par ghus sakta hai.

9.2

Plan kaise banayein

Imbalances aur attack

Yaad rakho
  • Plan imbalances se banta hai: material, minor pieces, pawn structure, space, files, king safety.
  • Jahan strong ho wahan khelo.
  • Opposite side castling = pawn storm race; same side castling mein center/queenside khelo.
  • Minority attack (b4-b5): Carlsbad structure mein c6 par kamzor pawn banana.
  • Piece activity: har piece ko kaam do; bure piece ko behtar square par lao.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 9.2.1 Imbalances dekho
  2. 9.2.2 Opposite side castling = pawn storm
  3. 9.2.3 Minority attack
  4. 9.2.4 Sawal 1: Tumhare paas kingside mein zyada space hai aur kings alag taraf…
  5. 9.2.5 Sawal 2: Plan banane ka pehla kadam?
  6. 9.2.6 Sawal 3: Minority attack (b4-b5) ka maksad kya hai?
  7. 9.2.7 Sawal 4: Kings alag taraf castled hain (opposite side)

9.2.1 Imbalances dekho

  • Plan banane ke liye farq (imbalances) dekho:
    • Material: kaun aage?
    • Minor pieces: bishop vs knight, bishop pair?
    • Pawn structure: kamzor pawns, passed pawns, majorities
    • Space: kiske paas zyada jagah?
    • Open files / weak squares
    • Development aur king safety
  • Phir: jahan tum strong ho wahan khelo.
  • Space zyada hai to us taraf attack karo.
  • Kamzori hai to use theek karo ya trades se bacho.

9.2.2 Opposite side castling = pawn storm

  • Jab kings alag-alag taraf castle karein, to dono apne pawns dushman king ki taraf daudaate hain (pawn storm).
  • Yahan speed sab kuch hai: jo pehle file kholega woh jeetega.
  • Same side castle ho to pawns aage badhana apne king ko kamzor karta hai: wahan center ya queenside mein khelo.

9.2.3 Minority attack

  • Queen's Gambit structure (Carlsbad): White kam pawns wali side (queenside: a, b vs a, b, c) se attack karta hai: b4-b5.
  • Maksad: c6 par ek kamzor pawn banana.
  • Yeh dikhata hai: plan pawn structure se aata hai.

9.2.4 Sawal 1: Tumhare paas kingside mein zyada space hai aur kings alag taraf…

Plan banane ka pehla kadam?

Jawab

  • Plan farq se aata hai.
  • Pehle dekho kis cheez mein tum aage ho, phir us farq ko badhao.

9.2.6 Sawal 3: Minority attack (b4-b5) ka maksad kya hai?

Minority attack (b4-b5) ka maksad kya hai?

Jawab

✓ Black ke queenside par ek kamzor pawn (jaise c6) banana

  • Kam pawns se zyada pawns par attack karke unki structure todo, phir kamzor pawn ko jeeto.

9.2.7 Sawal 4: Kings alag taraf castled hain (opposite side)

Kings alag taraf castled hain (opposite side). Sabse zaroori kya hai?

Jawab

✓ Speed: pehle file kholna aur attack

  • Opposite side castling mein race hoti hai.
  • Jo pehle attack khole, woh aksar jeetta hai.

9.3

Prophylaxis aur restriction

Opponent ka plan pehle roko

Yaad rakho
  • Har chaal se pehle: "Opponent kya chahta hai?" Use pehle roko.
  • Misaal: h3 (...Bg4 roko), Kh1 (checks se pehle hi bacho).
  • Restriction: dushman pieces ke achhe squares cheen lo.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 9.3.1 Prophylaxis
  2. 9.3.2 Sawal 1: Ruy Lopez mein White h3 kyun khelta hai?
  3. 9.3.3 Sawal 2: Prophylaxis ka pehla sawal kya hai?
  4. 9.3.4 Sawal 3: Castle ke baad h3 (luft) kyun khelte hain?
  5. 9.3.5 Sawal 4: Opponent ka knight d4 outpost par aana chahta hai

9.3.1 Prophylaxis

  • Prophylaxis (Nimzowitsch, Karpov, Petrosian): apni chaal se pehle poocho "Opponent kya karna chahta hai?" aur use pehle hi rok do.
  • h3 khelna taaki ...Bg4 pin na ho
  • Rook ko us file par rakhna jo khulne wali hai
  • King ko pehle hi safe square (Kh1) par le jaana taaki baad mein checks na aayein
  • Restriction: dushman pieces ke achhe squares cheen lo.
  • Jo piece hil nahi sakta, woh piece nahi.

9.3.2 Sawal 1: Ruy Lopez mein White h3 kyun khelta hai?

Ruy Lopez mein White h3 kyun khelta hai?

Jawab

✓ Black bishop ko g4 aane se rokne ke liye (prophylaxis)

9.3.3 Sawal 2: Prophylaxis ka pehla sawal kya hai?

Prophylaxis ka pehla sawal kya hai?

Jawab

✓ Opponent kya karna chahta hai?

  • Pehle opponent ka plan samjho, phir use shuru hone se pehle hi roko.

9.3.4 Sawal 3: Castle ke baad h3 (luft) kyun khelte hain?

Castle ke baad h3 (luft) kyun khelte hain?

Jawab

✓ Back-rank mate se bachne ke liye king ko saans dena

  • Luft king ko ek khaali square deta hai, taaki back rank par ek check mate na ban jaaye.

9.3.5 Sawal 4: Opponent ka knight d4 outpost par aana chahta hai

Opponent ka knight d4 outpost par aana chahta hai. Restriction ka tareeka?

Jawab

✓ Apne pawn (jaise c3 ya e3) se d4 ko cover kar do

  • Restriction = opponent ke achhe squares pehle hi band kar do, khaaskar pawn se.

9.4

Positional sacrifices

Material dekar position lena

Yaad rakho
  • Exchange sac (rook dekar minor piece) position ke liye: Dragon ka ...Rxc3!.
  • Kab: dushman king khule, dominant piece mile, ya dushman rook bekaar ho.
  • Gambit = pawn dekar development / initiative.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 9.4.1 Exchange sacrifice
  2. 9.4.2 Sawal 1: Positional sacrifice ka maksad?
  3. 9.4.3 Sawal 2: Sicilian Dragon mein Black ...Rxc3 kyun khelta hai?
  4. 9.4.4 Sawal 3: Exchange sacrifice mein tum kya dete ho aur kya lete ho?
  5. 9.4.5 Sawal 4: Gambit (pawn sacrifice) kab theek hai?

9.4.1 Exchange sacrifice

  • Exchange sacrifice: rook (5) dekar minor piece (3) lena, position ke liye.
  • Sicilian Dragon mein ...Rxc3! famous hai: White ke king ke saamne pawns toot jaate hain, aur e4 kamzor hota hai.
  • Kab karein: jab sacrifice se dushman king khul jaaye, ya tumhe dominant piece aur pawns milein, ya dushman ka rook kaam ka na ho.
  • Pawn sacrifice (gambit) se bhi development, open lines ya initiative milta hai.

9.4.2 Sawal 1: Positional sacrifice ka maksad?

Positional sacrifice ka maksad?

Jawab

✓ Lambe samay ka fayda: king safety tootna, strong pieces, initiative

9.4.3 Sawal 2: Sicilian Dragon mein Black ...Rxc3 kyun khelta hai?

Sicilian Dragon mein Black ...Rxc3 kyun khelta hai?

Jawab

✓ White king ke saamne pawns todne aur e4 par dabaav ke liye

  • Rook dekar knight liya: White ki queenside pawn structure tooti aur Black ko attack mila.
  • Material kam, par position behtar.

9.4.4 Sawal 3: Exchange sacrifice mein tum kya dete ho aur kya lete ho?

Exchange sacrifice mein tum kya dete ho aur kya lete ho?

Jawab

✓ Rook (5) dekar minor piece (3)

  • 2 point material kam, par badle mein position (strong piece, kamzor king, pawn structure).

9.4.5 Sawal 4: Gambit (pawn sacrifice) kab theek hai?

Gambit (pawn sacrifice) kab theek hai?

Jawab

✓ Jab badle mein development, center ya attack mile

  • Pawn dekar time (tempo), open lines ya center lena.
  • Agar badle mein kuch na mile to bas pawn kam hai.

Level 10

Openings 1: ideas aur e4 openings

Opening ke ideas, systems, Italian, Ruy Lopez, Sicilian, French aur Caro-Kann

  • Opening principles (Level 4) aur middlegame ke plans ke baad ab asli openings: naam, main ideas aur pehli 6-10 chaalein.
  • Har line board par khud khelo.
10.1

Opening ke ideas

Center, development, king safety

Yaad rakho
  • Har opening ke 3 kaam: center, development, king safety.
  • Open games (1.e4 e5) tactical, semi-open (Sicilian/French/Caro-Kann), closed (1.d4 d5) positional, Indian (1.d4 Nf6) hypermodern.
  • Openings ratne ki jagah har chaal ka idea samjho.
  • Imbalance: opening asymmetric ho to dono taraf jeetne ke mauke (jaise Sicilian).
  • Main line = sabse zyada khela gaya raasta; variation = side raasta. Har ek ka naam hota hai.
  • Online opening databases (Lichess/Chess.com explorer): masters ki asli stats dekho, apni pasand ka bias kam karo.
  • System = har jawab ke against lagbhag same setup (London, Colle, KIA): kam theory, par opponent ko kam pareshani.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 10.1.1 Teen kaam
  2. 10.1.2 Sawal 1: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 ke baad Black ki sabse natural chaal?
  3. 10.1.3 Imbalances, main lines, variations
  4. 10.1.4 Sawal 2: Sicilian 1.e4 c5 "imbalanced" kyun kehlaati hai?
  5. 10.1.5 Sawal 3: Nayi opening seekhne se pehle stats kahan dekho?
  6. 10.1.6 Sawal 4: "Main line" aur "sideline" mein kya farq hai?

10.1.1 Teen kaam

  • Har opening teen kaam karti hai:
    • Center control (pawns aur pieces se)
    • Development (saare minor pieces bahar)
    • King safety (castling)
  • Openings do family mein aati hain:
    • Open games 1.e4 e5: tez, tactical.
    • Semi-open 1.e4 ke against c5, e6, c6: Sicilian, French, Caro-Kann.
    • Closed 1.d4 d5: positional, plans lambe.
    • Indian 1.d4 Nf6: flexible, hypermodern (pieces se center control).

10.1.2 Sawal 1: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 ke baad Black ki sabse natural chaal?

1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 ke baad Black ki sabse natural chaal?

Jawab

✓ Nc6

  • Nc6 develop karta hai aur e5 ko protect.

10.1.3 Imbalances, main lines, variations

  • Imbalance: dono side alag cheezein lein (ek ke paas center, doosre ke paas bishop pair). Imbalance = jeetne ke mauke.
  • Main line: sabse popular raasta. Variation: side raasta. Har ek ka naam hota hai (Najdorf, Winawer...).
  • Opening databases (Lichess Opening Explorer, Chess.com): masters aur aam players ki asli stats. Apni "pasand" se zyada data par bharosa karo.

10.1.4 Sawal 2: Sicilian 1.e4 c5 "imbalanced" kyun kehlaati hai?

Sicilian 1.e4 c5 "imbalanced" kyun kehlaati hai?

Jawab

✓ Black ka pawn side se aata hai, structure alag-alag banti hai

  • Alag structures = dono ke liye jeetne ke mauke.

10.1.5 Sawal 3: Nayi opening seekhne se pehle stats kahan dekho?

Nayi opening seekhne se pehle stats kahan dekho?

Jawab

✓ Online opening database / explorer

  • Database masters ke hazaaron games dikhata hai.

10.1.6 Sawal 4: "Main line" aur "sideline" mein kya farq hai?

"Main line" aur "sideline" mein kya farq hai?

Jawab

✓ Main line sabse popular aur theory wali line, sideline kam khele jaane wali

  • Sideline galat nahi hoti, bas kam popular.
  • Beginner ko pehle main ideas samajhne chahiye, poori theory nahi.

10.2

Opening systems

London, Colle, Torre, KIA, English Botvinnik, Benko, Nimzo-Larsen, Van Geet

Yaad rakho
  • System = ek hi setup almost har jawab ke against. Fayda: kam theory. Nuksaan: opponent ko kam pareshaani, predictable.
  • London: d4, Bf4, e3, c3, Nf3, Bd3. Colle: d4, Nf3, e3, Bd3, c3 (bishop andar).
  • Torre: d4, Nf3, Bg5. KIA (King's Indian Attack): Nf3, g3, Bg2, O-O, d3, e4.
  • English Botvinnik: c4, Nc3, g3, Bg2, e4 (center ka "pinja"). Benko's opening: 1.g3. Nimzo-Larsen: 1.b3. Van Geet: 1.Nc3.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 10.2.1 System kya hai?
  2. 10.2.2 London System
  3. 10.2.3 Colle System
  4. 10.2.4 Torre Attack
  5. 10.2.5 King's Indian Attack (KIA)
  6. 10.2.6 English: Botvinnik system
  7. 10.2.7 Benko's Opening, Nimzo-Larsen, Van Geet
  8. 10.2.8 Sawal 1: Opening system ka sabse bada fayda?
  9. 10.2.9 Sawal 2: 1.b3 kis naam se jaana jaata hai?

10.2.1 System kya hai?

  • System = ek setup jo tum lagbhag har jawab ke against khelte ho.
  • Pehli 6-8 chaalein yaad, baaki plans.
  • Fayda: kam theory, jaane-pehchaane plans, time bachta hai.
  • Nuksaan: predictable, opponent ko aasaani se barabari mil sakti hai, aur kabhi exact jawab zaroori hota hai.

10.2.2 London System

  • Ek "system": lagbhag har jawab ke against same setup.
  • Club players mein bahut popular.

1. d4 d5 2. Bf4 Nf6 3. e3 e6 4. Nf3 c5 5. c3 Nc6 6. Nbd2 Bd6 7. Bg3 O-O 8. Bd3

  • 2.Bf4 bishop pawn chain ke bahar, pehle.
  • 3.e3
  • 5.c3 triangle: c3-d4-e3 solid center.
  • 6…Bd6 Black ...Bd6 se bishop trade maangta hai.
  • 7.Bg3 bishop bacha, h-file khul sakti hai.
  • 8.Bd3 Plan: O-O, Ne5, f4, kingside attack.

10.2.3 Colle System

  • Bishop c1 andar, plan: e3-e4 break.

1. d4 d5 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. e3 e6 4. Bd3 c5 5. c3 Nc6 6. Nbd2 Bd6 7. O-O O-O

  • 3.e3 bishop c1 ke peeche band (London se fark).
  • 4.Bd3 bishop h7 ki taraf.
  • 5.c3 "Colle triangle".
  • 7.O-O Plan: Re1 aur e4.

10.2.4 Torre Attack

  • 3.Bg5 knight f6 ko pin karta hai.

1. d4 Nf6 2. Nf3 e6 3. Bg5 c5 4. e3 Be7 5. Nbd2 b6 6. c3 Bb7 7. Bd3

  • 3.Bg5 Torre!
  • 4.e3 solid.
  • 7.Bd3 Pieces natural squares par.

10.2.5 King's Indian Attack (KIA)

  • King's Indian ka ulta setup White se.
  • Fischer ki favourite.

1. Nf3 d5 2. g3 Nf6 3. Bg2 e6 4. O-O Be7 5. d3 O-O 6. Nbd2 c5 7. e4

  • 2.g3 fianchetto.
  • 4.O-O Jaldi castle.
  • 5.d3
  • 7.e4 center break. Baad mein e5 aur kingside attack.

10.2.6 English: Botvinnik system

  • Pawns c4 aur e4 se d5 square par kabza.

1. c4 e5 2. Nc3 Nc6 3. g3 g6 4. Bg2 Bg7 5. e4 d6 6. Nge2

  • 1.c4 English.
  • 3.g3 fianchetto.
  • 5.e4! Botvinnik setup: d5 par pakad.
  • 6.Nge2 knight e2 se, f-pawn free.

10.2.7 Benko's Opening, Nimzo-Larsen, Van Geet

  • Kam khele jaane wale "surprise" systems:
    • Benko's Opening 1.g3: fianchetto, flexible.
    • Nimzo-Larsen 1.b3: bishop b2 se long diagonal.
    • Van Geet 1.Nc3: knight pehle (bahut naam hain: Dunst, Sleipner...).
  • Yahan 1.g3 dekho.

1. g3 d5 2. Bg2 e5

  • 1.g3
  • 2.Bg2 bishop long diagonal par: e4, d5, b7 par nazar.

10.2.8 Sawal 1: Opening system ka sabse bada fayda?

Opening system ka sabse bada fayda?

Jawab

✓ Kam theory: same setup har jawab ke against

  • System = kam yaad karna, plans pe dhyan.

10.2.9 Sawal 2: 1.b3 kis naam se jaana jaata hai?

1.b3 kis naam se jaana jaata hai?

Jawab

✓ Nimzo-Larsen Attack

  • Larsen ka favourite.

10.3

Italian Game

1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4

Yaad rakho
  • 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4: bishop kamzor f7 ko dekhta hai.
  • Giuoco Piano plan: c3 + d3, castle, Re1, Bb3, phir d4 break.
  • Two Knights mein 4.Ng5 d5! 5.exd5 Na5! sahi. 5...Nxd5? par Fried Liver 6.Nxf7!.
  • Two Knights mein 5...Nxd5? par 6.Nxf7! = Fried Liver attack. Sahi: 5...Na5.
  • Italian ke traps: f7 par Ng5 + Bc4, aur opponent ke jaldi galtiyon ko saza.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 10.3.1 Italian Game (Giuoco Piano)
  2. 10.3.2 Two Knights: Fried Liver ka khatra
  3. 10.3.3 Sawal 1: Italian Game mein White ka bishop c4 kis kamzor square ko target…
  4. 10.3.4 Fried Liver Attack
  5. 10.3.5 Abhyaas: Two Knights

10.3.1 Italian Game (Giuoco Piano)

  • Beginners ke liye sabse achhi opening: simple development aur saaf plans.

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Bc5 4. c3 Nf6 5. d3 d6 6. O-O O-O 7. Re1 a6 8. Bb3 Ba7

  • 1.e4 Center mein pawn aur bishop/queen ke liye raasta.
  • 2.Nf3 Knight develop, e5 par attack.
  • 3.Bc4 bishop f7 (kamzor square) ko dekhta hai.
  • 3…Bc5 Black bhi bishop c5 par: f2 ko dekhta hai.
  • 4.c3 idea: baad mein d4 se center.
  • 5.d3 shaant aur solid (Giuoco Pianissimo).
  • 6.O-O Castle! King safe.
  • Re1 rook ko center file par.
  • Bb3 bishop ko ...Na5 ya ...d5 se bachaya.
  • 8…Ba7 Dono taraf development poora. Plan: White Nbd2-f1-g3, h3, aur d4 ka break.

10.3.2 Two Knights: Fried Liver ka khatra

  • 3...Nf6 ke baad White 4.Ng5 se f7 par attack karta hai.

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Nf6 4. Ng5 d5 5. exd5 Na5

  • 4.Ng5 f7 par do attackers.
  • 4...d5! sahi jawab: bishop ka raasta band.
  • 5.exd5
  • 5...Na5! Sahi! Agar 5...Nxd5? to 6.Nxf7! (Fried Liver): king bahar aata hai aur bada attack.

10.3.3 Sawal 1: Italian Game mein White ka bishop c4 kis kamzor square ko target…

Italian Game mein White ka bishop c4 kis kamzor square ko target karta hai?

Jawab

✓ f7

  • f7 shuru mein sirf king protect karta hai.

10.3.4 Fried Liver Attack

  • Agar Black 5...Nxd5? khele to White knight sacrifice karta hai.

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Nf6 4. Ng5 d5 5. exd5 Nxd5 6. Nxf7 Kxf7 7. Qf3+ Ke6 8. Nc3

  • 5...Nxd5? galti.
  • 6.Nxf7! knight sacrifice: king aur queen par fork.
  • 6...Kxf7
  • 7.Qf3+ king aur d5 knight par attack.
  • 7...Ke6 king center mein!
  • 8.Nc3 aur pin par aur attackers. White ka bada attack.

10.3.5 Abhyaas: Two Knights

Two Knights: White ne 4.Ng5 khela, phir 5.exd5. Black ki sabse sahi chaal?

Jawab dekho

1… Na5

Ye bhi sahi: b5 Nd4

  • 5...Na5! bishop c4 par attack, Nxd5? ke Fried Liver se bachao.

10.4

Ruy Lopez (Spanish)

1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5

Yaad rakho
  • 3.Bb5: e5 ke defender c6 knight par pressure.
  • Morphy Defense 3...a6, White Ba4, O-O, Re1, c3, h3.
  • h3 = prophylaxis: ...Bg4 pin roka. Plan d4 aur Nbd2-f1-g3.
  • Black ki 3rd chaal ke options: 3...a6 (Morphy, main), 3...Nf6 (Berlin), 3...d6 (Steinitz), 3...f5 (Schliemann), 3...Bc5 (Classical), 3...Nd4 (Bird).
  • Exchange variation 4.Bxc6: Black ko doubled pawns, par bishop pair.

  2. 10.4.2 Sawal 1: Ruy Lopez mein 3.Bb5 ka main idea?
  3. 10.4.3 Ruy Lopez: Black ke 3rd move options
  4. 10.4.4 Sawal 2: Ruy Lopez mein 3...Nf6 ka naam?

10.4.1 Ruy Lopez: main line

  • 6.Re1 e4 protect.

  • 8.c3 taaki d4 khel sakein aur bishop ke liye c2 ka ghar.
  • 9.h3 ...Bg4 pin rokta hai. Plan: d4, Nbd2-f1-g3.

10.5

Sicilian Defense

1.e4 c5: sabse fighting jawab

Yaad rakho
  • 1...c5: side se center par attack, asymmetric position = jeet ke chances.
  • Open Sicilian: 2.Nf3 3.d4 cxd4 4.Nxd4. Black ko extra center pawn milta hai.
  • Najdorf 5...a6. English Attack (Be3, f3, Qd2, O-O-O, g4) = opposite castling attack race.
  • 2.Nf3 ke baad Black: 2...d6 (Najdorf/Dragon), 2...e6 (Taimanov/Kan/Scheveningen), 2...Nc6 (Classical, Sveshnikov).
  • White ke anti-Sicilians: 2.c3 Alapin, 2.Nc3 Closed, Grand Prix (f4), Smith-Morra gambit (2.d4 cxd4 3.c3).

  • 1...c5 side se center par attack. Position asymmetric = jeet ke chances.
  • 3.d4 White center kholta hai.

  • 7...Be6 development.

French aur Caro-Kann

1.e4 e6 aur 1.e4 c6: solid defenses

Yaad rakho
  • French 1...e6 2...d5: pawn chain d4-e5 banti hai, Black ...c5 se base par vaar karta hai.
  • French ki kamzori: c8 bishop band (bad bishop).
  • Caro-Kann 1...c6 2...d5: solid, aur light bishop ...Bf5 se bahar aata hai.
  • French ke variations: Advance (3.e5), Winawer (3.Nc3 Bb4), Tarrasch (3.Nd2), Exchange (3.exd5).
  • Caro-Kann ke variations: Classical (4...Bf5), Advance (3.e5), Exchange, Panov (c4).
  • French Advance trap: 6...cxd4 7.cxd4 Nxd4?? 8.Nxd4 Qxd4 9.Bb5+ (discovered attack, queen gayi).

Petrov aur Philidor (club): dono taraf

Yaad rakho
  • Petrov main: 3.Nxe5 d6 4.Nf3 Nxe4 5.d4 d5 6.Bd3. 5.Nc3 Nxc3 6.dxc3: opposite castling.
  • Petrov mein 3...Nxe4? nahi. Aur 4.Nxf7?! (Cochrane) dikhe to 4...Kxf7 aur aaram.
  • Philidor: ...d6, ...Nf6, ...Nbd7, ...Be7, ...O-O, ...c6 (Hanham/Lion). e5 ko pawn se pakdo.
  • Philidor mein ...Bg4? + Nxe5! = Legal's mate ka khatra.
  • Philidor ke khilaaf White: d4, Nc3, Bc4, phir Ng5/Bxf7+ tricks.

1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 g6 3. Nc3 d5 4. cxd5 Nxd5 5. e4 Nxc3 6. bxc3 Bg7

  • 6...Bg7 bishop d4 par. Aage ...c5.

11.3

Gambits

Kyun gambit, semi-open files, King's, Danish, Evans, Albin, Benko, Blackmar-Diemer, Smith-Morra, Staunton, Reti gambit

Yaad rakho
  • Gambit = development (tempo) aur open lines ke liye pawn dena.
  • Semi-open (half-open) file: sirf dushman ka pawn. Rook ke liye attack ka raasta. Gambits aksar yeh files aur tempo dete hain.
  • White gambits: King's (2.f4), Danish (d4, c3), Evans (b4), Smith-Morra (vs Sicilian), Blackmar-Diemer (d4 e4), Staunton (vs Dutch), Reti gambit (b3 vs French), Queen's Gambit.
  • Black gambits: Albin (2...e5 vs QG), Benko (3...b5).
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 11.3.1 Gambit kyun?
  2. 11.3.2 King's Gambit
  3. 11.3.3 Danish Gambit
  4. 11.3.4 Evans Gambit
  5. 11.3.5 Smith-Morra Gambit (vs Sicilian)
  6. 11.3.6 Blackmar-Diemer Gambit
  7. 11.3.7 Staunton Gambit (vs Dutch)
  8. 11.3.8 Reti Gambit (vs French)
  9. 11.3.9 Albin Counter-Gambit (Black)
  10. 11.3.10 Benko Gambit (Black)
  11. 11.3.11 Sawal 1: Gambit dene wale ko badle mein kya chahiye?
  12. 11.3.12 Sawal 2: Semi-open file kya hai?

11.3.1 Gambit kyun?

  • Gambit = shuru mein pawn (kabhi piece) dekar badle mein development (tempo), open lines aur attack lena.
  • Semi-open (half-open) file: jisme sirf dushman ka pawn ho.
  • Tumhare rook ke liye attack ka raasta.
  • Gambits aksar aisi files aur tempo dete hain.
  • Gambit khelo to tez development aur attack zaroori.
  • Jawab dena ho to: development karo, aur sahi waqt par pawn wapas de do.

11.3.2 King's Gambit

  • 19vi sadi ka sabse romantic gambit.
  • f-file khulti hai.

1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Nf3 g5 4. Bc4 Bg7 5. O-O

  • 2.f4 King's Gambit.
  • 2...exf4 accepted.
  • 3...g5 pawn bachane ki koshish.
  • 5.O-O aur f-file par rook: f7 par pressure.

11.3.3 Danish Gambit

  • Do pawns de kar do bishops seedhe Black ke king ki taraf.

1. e4 e5 2. d4 exd4 3. c3 dxc3 4. Bc4 cxb2 5. Bxb2

  • 3.c3
  • 4.Bc4 doosra pawn bhi.
  • 5.Bxb2 bishops c4 aur b2: f7 aur g7 par nishaana.

11.3.4 Evans Gambit

  • Italian mein pawn dekar c3-d4 se tez center.
  • (Kabhi TV advert mein bhi aaya!)

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Bc5 4. b4 Bxb4 5. c3 Ba5 6. d4 exd4 7. O-O

  • 4.b4 Evans.
  • 5.c3 tempo ke saath bishop par attack.
  • 6.d4 center khula.
  • 7.O-O Tez development, Black ka king center mein.

11.3.5 Smith-Morra Gambit (vs Sicilian)

  • Pawn ke badle open c- aur d-files aur tez development.

1. e4 c5 2. d4 cxd4 3. c3 dxc3 4. Nxc3 Nc6 5. Nf3 d6 6. Bc4 e6 7. O-O

  • 3.c3 Morra.
  • 4.Nxc3 knight bahar.
  • 7.O-O White ke rooks jaldi c1/d1 par.

11.3.6 Blackmar-Diemer Gambit

  • 1.d4 players ka sharp hathiyaar.
  • (Scandinavian 1.e4 d5 2.d4 se bhi aa sakta hai.)

1. d4 d5 2. e4 dxe4 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. f3 exf3 5. Nxf3

  • 2.e4!?
  • 4.f3 pawn de kar f-file.
  • 5.Nxf3 tez development, Bd3, O-O, Qe1-h4 plan.

11.3.7 Staunton Gambit (vs Dutch)

  • Dutch 1...f5 ke against pawn dekar king ki kamzor diagonal par attack.

1. d4 f5 2. e4 fxe4 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. Bg5

  • 2.e4!? Staunton.
  • 4.Bg5 knight par pressure, f3 se pawn wapas ya attack.

11.3.8 Reti Gambit (vs French)

  • e4 pawn chhod kar bishop b2 long diagonal, queen e2, aur long castle ke saath attack.

1. e4 e6 2. b3 d5 3. Bb2 dxe4 4. Nc3 Nf6 5. Qe2

  • 2.b3
  • 3.Bb2 pawn gaya.
  • 5.Qe2 pawn wapas ya O-O-O aur g4 se attack.

11.3.9 Albin Counter-Gambit (Black)

  • Black Queen's Gambit ke against khud pawn deta hai.
  • d4 pawn White ko dabata hai.

1. d4 d5 2. c4 e5 3. dxe5 d4 4. Nf3 Nc6

  • 2...e5!? Albin.
  • 3...d4 space.
  • 4...Nc6 pawn wapas lene ki taiyaari, tez development.

11.3.10 Benko Gambit (Black)

  • Pawn ke badle a- aur b-files par lamba pressure.
  • Endgame mein bhi asar.

1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 c5 3. d5 b5 4. cxb5 a6 5. bxa6 Bxa6 6. Nc3 d6

  • 3...b5 Benko.
  • 5...Bxa6 semi-open a- aur b-files.
  • 6…d6 Rooks a8, b8 par aayenge.

11.4

Advanced opening traps

Lasker, Caro-Kann, Three Knights, Petrov copycat, QGA, Cambridge Springs, Mortimer, Noah's Ark, Fischer, Siberian, Stafford, Vienna

Yaad rakho
  • Opponent koi pawn "free" chhode to pehle socho: trap to nahi?
  • Blackburne Shilling: 3...Nd4 ke baad 4.Nxe5? lalach, ...Qg5! aur smothered mate.
  • Sahi jawab: 4.Nxd4 ya 4.O-O.
  • Traps khud na bhi khelo, unke tactical ingredients (pin, fork, discovered attack, underpromotion) seekho.
  • Copycat mat bano: opponent ki nakal (Petrov) se trap mein phans sakte ho.
  • Bishop trap (Noah's Ark): ...c5-c4 se bishop b3 band.

11.4.1 Sawal 1: Jab opponent koi pawn "free" chhod de, sabse pehle kya socho?

Jab opponent koi pawn "free" chhod de, sabse pehle kya socho?

Jawab

✓ Yeh trap to nahi? Lene ke baad unki CCT kya hai?

11.4.2 Advanced traps: ingredients seekho

  • Yeh traps alphabetical order mein, har opening se ek.
  • Agar tum woh opening kabhi na bhi khelo, ingredients seekho: pin, fork, discovered attack, underpromotion, trapped piece.
  • Yahi patterns middlegame mein bhi aate hain.

11.4.3 Albin: Lasker trap (underpromotion!)

  • Black ka pawn aakhir mein knight banta hai!

1. d4 d5 2. c4 e5 3. dxe5 d4 4. e3 Bb4+ 5. Bd2 dxe3 6. Bxb4 exf2+ 7. Ke2 fxg1=N+

  • 4.e3? galti.
  • 4...Bb4+
  • 5...dxe3!
  • 6.Bxb4?
  • 6...exf2+
  • 7.Ke2
  • 7...fxg1=N+! knight promotion check ke saath. 8.Rxg1 Bg4+ aur queen gayi.

11.4.4 Caro-Kann trap

  • Natural lagne wali chaal se smothered mate!

1. e4 c6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 dxe4 4. Nxe4 Nd7 5. Qe2 Ngf6 6. Nd6#

  • 5.Qe2 trap set: e7 pawn pinned.
  • 5...Ngf6??
  • 6.Nd6# e7 pawn pinned hai, isliye capture nahi kar sakta. Smothered mate!

11.4.5 Three Knights: `Nxe5` trick

  • 3...Bc5? natural lagta hai par 4.Nxe5! (fork trick) se White center jeetta hai.

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Nc3 Bc5 4. Nxe5 Nxe5 5. d4 Bd6 6. dxe5 Bxe5

  • 3...Bc5? behtar 3...Nf6.
  • 4.Nxe5! piece "sacrifice".
  • 5.d4 fork: bishop aur knight. Piece wapas aur bada center.

11.4.6 Petrov: copycat ki saza

  • Black ne White ki nakal ki (3...Nxe4?).

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. Nxe5 Nxe4 4. Qe2 Nf6 5. Nc6+

  • 3...Nxe4? nakal. Sahi: pehle 3...d6.
  • 4.Qe2 knight par pin wali threat.
  • 4...Nf6??
  • 5.Nc6+ discovered check: queen d8 gayi.

11.4.7 Queen's Gambit Accepted trap

  • Pawn bachane ka lalach: a8 rook gaya.

1. d4 d5 2. c4 dxc4 3. e3 b5 4. a4 c6 5. axb5 cxb5 6. Qf3

  • 3...b5?
  • 4.a4 pawn chain todo.
  • 5...cxb5
  • 6.Qf3! fork: rook a8 (long diagonal) par attack.

11.4.8 Cambridge Springs trap

  • Elephant trap se shuru, phir queen a5 se pin.

1. d4 d5 2. c4 e6 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. Bg5 Nbd7 5. e3 c6 6. Nf3 Qa5 7. Bd3 dxc4 8. Bxc4 Ne4

  • 4...Nbd7 (elephant trap set).
  • 6...Qa5 Cambridge Springs: c3 knight pinned.
  • 7.Bd3? common galti.
  • 7...dxc4! bishop ko hataya.
  • 8...Ne4! c3 par double pressure aur g5 bishop par attack.

11.4.9 Ruy Lopez: Mortimer trap

  • 4...Ne7 galti lagti hai, par trap hai.

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 Nf6 4. d3 Ne7 5. Nxe5 c6 6. Ba4 Qa5+

  • 4...Ne7 trap.
  • 5.Nxe5? free pawn?
  • 5...c6 bishop par attack.
  • 6...Qa5+ check aur fork: e5 knight gaya.

11.4.10 Ruy Lopez: Noah's Ark trap

  • White ka bishop b3 pawns mein qaid!

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Ba4 d6 5. d4 b5 6. Bb3 Nxd4 7. Nxd4 exd4 8. Qxd4 c5 9. Qd5 Be6 10. Qc6+ Bd7 11. Qd5 c4

  • 8.Qxd4?? (sahi: 8.Bd5)
  • 8...c5! queen bhagao.
  • 11...c4 bishop b3 trap: "Noah's Ark".

11.4.11 Sicilian: Fischer trap (Fischer vs Reshevsky 1958)

  • Accelerated Dragon mein 8...Na5? ki saza.

1. e4 c5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 cxd4 4. Nxd4 g6 5. Nc3 Bg7 6. Be3 Nf6 7. Bc4 O-O 8. Bb3 Na5 9. e5 Ne8 10. Bxf7+ Kxf7 11. Ne6

  • 8...Na5?
  • 9.e5! knight bhagao.
  • 10.Bxf7+!!
  • 11.Ne6!! agar dxe6 to Qxd8; queen trapped. White jeet raha hai.

11.4.12 Smith-Morra: Siberian trap

  • Black ki taraf se trap: Qh2# ki threat.

1. e4 c5 2. d4 cxd4 3. c3 dxc3 4. Nxc3 Nc6 5. Nf3 e6 6. Bc4 Qc7 7. O-O Nf6 8. Qe2 Ng4 9. h3 Nd4

  • 8...Ng4 h2 par nishaana.
  • 9.h3??
  • 9...Nd4! queen par attack. Agar Nxd4 to Qh2#. Queen jaati hai.

11.4.13 Stafford Gambit trap

  • Online popular gambit: White lalach mein queen le, Black mate karta hai.

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. Nxe5 Nc6 4. Nxc6 dxc6 5. d3 Bc5 6. Bg5 Nxe4 7. Bxd8 Bxf2+ 8. Ke2 Bg4#

  • 6.Bg5?
  • 6...Nxe4! queen ki parwah nahi.
  • 7.Bxd8??
  • 7...Bxf2+
  • 8...Bg4# Mate!

11.4.14 Vienna Game trap

  • "Frankenstein-Dracula" variation: dono taraf jungli chaalein.

1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nf6 3. Bc4 Nxe4 4. Qh5 Nd6 5. Bb3 Nc6 6. Nb5 g6 7. Qf3 f5 8. Qd5 Qe7 9. Nxc7+ Kd8 10. Nxa8

  • 3...Nxe4 fork trick.
  • 4.Qh5 mate threat f7.
  • 7.Qf3 f7 par phir.
  • 8.Qd5 mate threat aur c7.
  • 9.Nxc7+
  • 10.Nxa8 rook jeeta (par Black ke paas compensation hai).

11.5

Apna repertoire banao

Kya khelna hai, kaise yaad karna hai

Yaad rakho
  • White: 1.e4 + Italian (ya 1.d4 + London).
  • Black vs 1.e4: 1...e5 ya Caro-Kann. Black vs 1.d4: QGD ya Slav.
  • Pehle 6-8 chaalon ke ideas; har game ke baad opening check karo.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 11.5.1 Simple repertoire (beginner se club level)
  2. 11.5.2 Sawal 1: 1200 rating par opening kaise padhni chahiye?
  3. 11.5.3 Sawal 2: Repertoire banane ka achha tareeka?
  4. 11.5.4 Sawal 3: Ek opening mein haar gaye
  5. 11.5.5 Sawal 4: Opening seekhte waqt sabse zaroori kya hai?

11.5.1 Simple repertoire (beginner se club level)

  • White: 1.e4 aur Italian Game. (Ya 1.d4 + London System agar positional pasand ho.)
  • Black vs 1.e4: 1...e5 (open games) ya Caro-Kann (solid).
  • Black vs 1.d4: Queen's Gambit Declined ya Slav.
  • Kaise seekhein:
  • Pehle 6-8 chaalon ke ideas samjho, lambi theory nahi.
  • Har game ke baad dekho kahan opening se bahar aaye, wahan ka sahi move note karo.
  • 1600+ ke baad dheere-dheere gehri lines aur sideline traps.
  • Master games dekho apni openings ke: plans wahi se aate hain.

11.5.2 Sawal 1: 1200 rating par opening kaise padhni chahiye?

Jawab

✓ Ideas aur principles, 6-8 chaal

Jawab

✓ White ke liye ek opening, Black ke liye 1.e4 aur 1.d4 ke ek-ek jawab

  • Chhota aur fixed repertoire: wahi positions baar-baar aayengi aur unke plans samajh aayenge.

11.5.4 Sawal 3: Ek opening mein haar gaye

Ek opening mein haar gaye. Kya karein?

Jawab

✓ Game dekho kahan galti hui aur woh line seekh lo

  • Haar se repertoire mazboot hota hai: galti wali line ko theek karo.

11.5.5 Sawal 4: Opening seekhte waqt sabse zaroori kya hai?

Opening seekhte waqt sabse zaroori kya hai?

Jawab

✓ Har chaal ka idea aur middlegame ka plan samajhna

  • Idea samjhe to opponent ke alag chalne par bhi sahi chaal mil jaati hai.

11.7

Nimzo-Indian, QID, Bogo, Catalan (club)

4.e3 Rubinstein, 4.Qc2 Classical, Samisch; QID 4.g3; Catalan open/closed

Yaad rakho
  • Nimzo Rubinstein 4.e3: ...O-O, ...d5, ...c5. Classical 4.Qc2: ...O-O, ...d5 ya ...c5.
  • Nimzo ka trade ...Bxc3: White ko 2 bishops, Black ko better structure (doubled c pawns).
  • QID 4.g3 Ba6: c4 par chot. 5.b3 Bb4+ 6.Bd2 Be7.
  • Bogo-Indian 3...Bb4+: Nimzo ka "Nf3" version. Simple, solid.
  • Catalan g3 + Bg2: long diagonal se queenside par dabaav. Black ...dxc4 (open) ya ...Be7, ...c6 (closed).

11.7.6 Abhyaas: Nimzo Rubinstein

Nimzo Rubinstein: White ne a3 se bishop se sawaal kiya. Black?

Jawab dekho

1… Bxc3

Ye bhi sahi: Ba5

  • ...Bxc3 trade: White ke doubled pawns.
  • Phir ...dxc4 aur ...Qc7.

11.8

Yaad rakho
  • Modern Benoni: Black queenside majority (...b5), White center (e5 break, f4). Taimanov f4+Bb5+ sabse khatarnaak.

  • Budapest ...e5: White Bf4, Nf3, e3, Nbd2/Nc3; Black pawn wapas leta hai. Trap: axb4?? par ...Nd3#.
  • Dutch Leningrad (...g6) aur Stonewall (...d5, ...e6, ...c6): e4 square ki ladai.
  • Dutch ke khilaaf White: Staunton 2.e4 ya Bg5, Nc3, e4 break.

Level 12

Endgames 1: king aur pawns

Endgame ke themes, do bishops se mate, opposition, square rule, triangulation

  • Endgame mein king ladta hai aur pawns queen bante hain.
  • Pehle bade themes aur king-pawn endings.
12.1

Endgame ke bade themes

Active king, passed pawn ka safar, rook 7th rank par

Yaad rakho
  • Endgame mein king ko center aur aage lao: mate ka khatra kam, king strong piece.
  • Passed pawn ko safe raasta do: king ya rook se escort, blockade todo.
  • Rook 7th rank par: pawns aur king dono atakte hain (Capablanca-Tartakower).
  • Famous: Tal-Lisitsin (aggressive king), Seirawan-Kasparov (passed pawn ka safar).
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 12.1.1 Endgame ke 3 bade themes
  2. 12.1.2 Khud khelo: Pawn ko queen banao
  3. 12.1.3 Abhyaas: Rook ko 7th rank par lao
  4. 12.1.4 Sawal 1: Endgame mein king kahan hona chahiye?
  5. 12.1.5 Sawal 2: Endgame mein "passed pawn" ke saath kya karo?

12.1.1 Endgame ke 3 bade themes

  • Aggressive king: endgame mein king center aur aage jaata hai, pawns khaata hai, apne pawns ko support karta hai. (Tal vs Lisitsin)
  • Passed pawn ka safe safar: passed pawn ko escort karo (king/rook se), blockader ko hatao. (Seirawan vs Kasparov)
  • Rook on the 7th: rook dushman ki 7th rank par: pawns par attack aur king band. (Capablanca vs Tartakower, 1924)

12.1.2 Khud khelo: Pawn ko queen banao

King ko active karo: pawn ko escort karke queen banao (20 chaal).

Hint: Pehle king aage (pawn se aage), opposition lo, phir pawn.

12.2.1 Do bishops se mate

  • Do bishops paas-paas diagonals par milkar ek deewar banate hain jo king ko kaat deti hai.
  • 1.
  • Bishops center ke paas, king ko ek kone ki taraf dhakelo.
  • 2.
  • Apna king saath lao: bina king ke mate nahi hota.
  • 3.
  • King kone mein aaye to bishops se check aur band.
  • 4.
  • Stalemate ka dhyan: har chaal par dekho ki king ke paas chaal bachi hai.
  • Yaad: queen, rook, do rooks, queen+rook ke mates Level 3 mein seekhe.

12.3

King aur pawn: opposition

K+P vs K, key squares

Yaad rakho
  • Endgame mein king center mein lao: woh fighter hai (~4 points).
  • Opposition: kings aamne-saamne, beech mein ek square; jisne chaal nahi chalni uske paas opposition.
  • Key squares: pawn ke 2 square aage ki row ke 3 squares. King wahan = pawn queen.
  • Square ka rule: dushman king pawn ke box mein aa sake to pawn pakda jaayega.
  • K+P vs K: king pawn ke aage ho aur opposition tumhare paas = jeet. Kiski chaal hai, usse result badalta hai.

12.3.1 Endgame mein king ladta hai

  • Endgame mein king ko center mein lao: woh ek strong piece hai (lagbhag 4 points).
  • Opposition: jab kings ek hi line mein ho aur beech mein ek square ho, to jisne chaal nahi chalni uske paas opposition hai.
  • Opposition wala king doosre ko peeche dhakelta hai.
  • Key squares: pawn ke 2 square aage wali row ke 3 squares.
  • Agar tumhara king wahan pahunch gaya, pawn queen banega.

12.4

Square rule aur triangulation

King pawn ko pakad sakta hai? Reti ka study, tempo ka khel

Yaad rakho
  • Square rule: pawn se promotion tak ek box. Dushman king (apni chaal ke saath) box mein aa sake to pawn pakdega.
  • Reti study: king ek saath do kaam kar sakta hai (pawn pakadna aur apna pawn support): diagonal chaal ka jaadu.
  • Triangulation: king teen squares ke triangle mein ghoom kar ek tempo "khota" hai, taaki opponent ko chaal chalni pade (Alburt-Kasparov).
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 12.4.1 Square ka rule
  2. 12.4.2 Sawal 1: White ki chaal
  3. 12.4.3 Sawal 2: Black ki chaal
  4. 12.4.4 Reti ka jaadu (1921)
  5. 12.4.5 Reti study: chaal-dar-chaal
  6. 12.4.6 Khud khelo: Draw bachao
  7. 12.4.7 Triangulation
  8. 12.4.8 Sawal 3: Triangulation ka maksad?

12.4.1 Square ka rule

  • Pawn se promotion square tak ek square (box) banao.
  • Agar dushman king (apni chaal ke saath) is box ke andar aa sakta hai, to woh pawn ko pakad lega.
  • Yahan Black ki chaal hai aur king e5 box ke andar hai: woh pawn pakad lega.

12.4.2 Sawal 1: White ki chaal

White ki chaal. Kya Black king f5 pawn ko pakad sakta hai?

Jawab

✓ Nahi: pawn queen banega

  • a5 ke baad box a5-d5-d8-a8 hai.
  • f5 king bahar hai: pakad nahi payega.

12.4.3 Sawal 2: Black ki chaal

Black ki chaal. Kya Black king a5 pawn ko pakad lega?

Jawab

✓ Nahi

  • Box a5-a8-d8-d5.
  • King f6 box se bahar, apni chaal ke saath bhi e6 tak hi: nahi pakad sakta.

12.4.4 Reti ka jaadu (1921)

  • White: king h8, pawn c6.
  • Black: king a6, pawn h5.
  • Lagta hai White haar gaya: black pawn bahut aage, white king door.
  • Par king diagonal chal kar do kaam ek saath karta hai: black pawn ki taraf bhi aur apne pawn ki taraf bhi.
  • 1.Kg7! h4 2.Kf6 Kb6 3.Ke5! aur ab ya to pawn pakdega ya apna pawn queen karega.
  • Draw!

12.4.5 Reti study: chaal-dar-chaal

  • Diagonal king ka kamaal.

1. Kg7 h4 2. Kf6 Kb6 3. Ke5 Kxc6 4. Kf4

  • 1.Kg7! diagonal: dono taraf ke kareeb.
  • 2.Kf6 box ke kareeb.
  • 2...Kb6 (agar 2...h3 3.Ke7 h2 4.c7 dono queen banenge)
  • 3.Ke5! ab c6 ko support bhi.
  • 3...Kxc6
  • 4.Kf4 pawn pakda. Draw!

12.4.6 Khud khelo: Draw bachao

Ab tum karo: Reti study mein haar se bacho aur draw karo (10 chaal).

Hint: King ko diagonal par chalao: Kg7, Kf6, Ke5.

Course mein ye position khelo ›

12.4.7 Triangulation

  • Kabhi position aisi hoti hai ki jiski chaal ho woh haare (zugzwang).
  • Agar tumhari chaal hai, to king ko teen squares ke triangle mein ghumao: tum 3 chaal mein wapas wahin, opponent ke paas sirf 2 squares ka aana-jaana.
  • Ek tempo kho kar ab opponent ki chaal wali wahi position!
  • Famous: Alburt vs Kasparov.

12.4.8 Sawal 3: Triangulation ka maksad?

Triangulation ka maksad?

Jawab

✓ Ek tempo khona taaki wahi position opponent ki chaal ke saath aaye

  • Zugzwang ka fayda uthane ke liye.

Pawn endgame tricks, Lucena, Philidor, Vancura, minor pieces aur theory

13.1

Pawn endgame tricks

Breakthrough, outside passer, triangulation

Yaad rakho
  • Passed pawn ko aage badhao: "passed pawns must be pushed".
  • Outside passed pawn dushman king ko kinare kheenchta hai.
  • Triangulation: king teen squares mein ghoom kar tempo waste karta hai.
  • Breakthrough: 3 vs 3 pawns mein b6! jaisi sacrifice se passed pawn.

13.1.1 Passed pawn

  • Passed pawn: jiske raste mein ya bagal ki files mein koi dushman pawn na ho.
  • "Passed pawns must be pushed!"
  • Outside passed pawn (kinare wala): dushman king ko door kheenchta hai, tumhara king doosri taraf pawns kha leta hai.
  • Protected passed pawn: apne pawn se protected = bahut strong.
  • Triangulation: king teen squares ka triangle bana kar ek tempo waste karta hai taaki opposition mile.

Breakthrough! Teen pawns vs teen pawns.

1. b6 axb6 2. c6 bxc6 3. a6

  • 1.b6! agar cxb6 to 2.a6! aur bxa6 3.c6 queen banega.
  • Agar axb6 to 2.c6!.
