13.2

Rook endgames: Lucena aur Philidor

Sabse common endgame

Yaad rakho
  • Aadhe endgames rook endgames hote hain.
  • Lucena (jeet): rook 4th rank par la kar bridge banao.
  • Philidor (draw): rook 6th rank par; pawn aage aaye to rook peeche jaa kar checks.
  • Tarrasch rule: rook passed pawn ke peeche. Active rook > passive rook.
  • Vancura defense: rook side se (f6 jaisi rank par) a-pawn par attack aur side se checks. Rook pawn + rook vs rook ka draw.
  • Philidor jab pawn 5th rank par shuru ho: rook 6th rank par jab tak pawn 6th par na aaye, phir peeche se checks.

13.2.1 Rook endgames sabse zyada aate hain

  • Lagbhag aadhe endgames mein rooks hote hain. 2 positions zaroor yaad karo:
    • Lucena (jeet): pawn 7th rank par, king uske aage. Technique: "bridge banao" rook se.
    • Philidor (draw): defending side ka rook 3rd rank (apni taraf se 6th) par, jab tak pawn aage na aaye. Pawn aaya to rook peeche jaa kar check dete raho.
  • Aur rule: rook passed pawn ke peeche rakho (Tarrasch rule), aage nahi.
  • Active rook passive rook se behtar.

13.2.2 Lucena: bridge banana

  • White ka king b8 pawn ke aage atka hai.
  • Black rook side se check dega.

1. Rd1+ Ke7 2. Rd4 Ra1 3. Kc7 Rc1+ 4. Kb6 Rb1+ 5. Kc6 Rc1+ 6. Kb5 Rb1+ 7. Rb4

  • 1.Rd1+ black king ko ek file door dhakelo.
  • 2.Rd4! rook 4th rank par: yahi bridge banega.
  • 3.Kc7 king bahar.
  • 3…Rc1+ Checks shuru.
  • 4.Kb6 King rook ki taraf aata hai.
  • 7.Rb4! Bridge! Checks khatam, pawn queen banega.

Ab tum Lucena jeeto: pawn ko queen banao (20 chaal).

Hint: Rd1+, phir rook 4th rank par (Rd4), phir king bahar.

13.2.4 Philidor: draw kaise bachayein

  • Black ka rook 6th rank par white king ko aage aane se rokta hai.
  • Agar White e6 khele, to ab king ke liye 6th rank par koi chhupne ki jagah nahi.
  • Tab Black rook ko peeche (1st rank) le jaata hai aur peeche se checks deta rehta hai.
  • Draw!

Tum Black ho. 15 chaal tak haar se bacho aur draw pakka karo. Rook 6th rank par rakho jab tak pawn e6 na aaye.

  • Tarrasch rule: rook pawn ke peeche se uske saath aage badhta hai, aur zyada active hota hai.

13.2.7 Vancura defense

  • Rook + a-pawn vs rook, jab White rook pawn ke aage (a8) ho aur pawn a6 par.
  • Black rook side se (f6) pawn par attack karta hai.
  • White king paas aaye to side se checks.
  • Black king g7/h7 par.
  • Result: draw.

  • Pawn 6th par aaye to rook peeche jaakar checks.

13.3

Minor pieces aur theory

Good/bad bishop, wrong corner, kaun jeetta hai

Yaad rakho
  • K+Q vs K, K+R vs K jeet. K+B vs K, K+N vs K, K+N+N vs K draw.
  • K+B+N vs K jeet par mushkil: bishop ke color wale corner mein mate.
  • Wrong bishop + h-pawn: corner ka color bishop se alag = draw.
  • Open board, dono kinaron par pawns = bishop behtar. Band position = knight.
  • Opposite color bishops: aksar draw.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 13.3.1 Kaunse endgames jeet, kaunse draw
  2. 13.3.2 Sawal 1: Wrong bishop
  3. 13.3.3 Sawal 2: K + do knights vs akela K?
  4. 13.3.4 Sawal 3: Bishop vs knight endgame
  5. 13.3.5 Sawal 4: King + ek bishop vs akela king?
  6. 13.3.6 Diagram: Wrong bishop

13.3.1 Kaunse endgames jeet, kaunse draw

  • K+Q vs K, K+R vs K: jeet
  • K+B+N vs K: jeet par mushkil (corner us color ka jo bishop control karta hai)
  • K+N+N vs K: draw (force nahi kar sakte)
  • K+B vs K, K+N vs K: draw
  • K+Q vs K+R: aksar jeet (technique lambi)
  • K+R vs K+B, K+R vs K+N: aksar draw
  • K+R+P vs K+R: depends: Lucena jeet, Philidor draw
  • Opposite color bishops + pawns: aksar draw chahe ek-do pawn zyada ho

Wrong bishop: White ke paas h-pawn aur light-square bishop hai. Black king h8 corner mein. Result?

Jawab

✓ Draw: bishop h8 (dark square) control nahi karta

  • Corner square ka color bishop se alag hai, king nikala nahi ja sakta.
  • Famous draw!

✓ Bishop

Level 14

Pro 1: practical chess

Deep calculation, time management, psychology, analysis, jeetne ke tips

  • Ab practical player banna hai: gehri calculation, clock, psychology, apne games ka analysis, aur jeetne ke tips.
14.1

Deep calculation

Grandmaster ki tarah sochna

Yaad rakho
  • Candidate moves ka tree banao, har branch ek baar.
  • Kotov rule: line baar-baar mat dekho, ek baar gehra dekho aur faisla karo.
  • Forcing line ke beech quiet moves mat bhoolo.
  • Aakhri check: opponent ka sabse forcing jawab kya hai?
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 14.1.1 Calculation ke pro tips
  2. 14.1.2 Abhyaas: Calculate karo
  3. 14.1.3 Sawal 1: Calculation ke end mein sabse zaroori kya hai?
  4. 14.1.4 Abhyaas: Gehri calculation
  5. 14.1.5 Abhyaas: Gehri calculation

14.1.1 Calculation ke pro tips

  • Tree banao: candidate moves → har ek ke 1-2 best jawab → aage. Har branch ek baar, saaf.
  • Kotov rule: ek line ko baar-baar mat dekho. Ek baar gehra dekho, faisla karo.
  • Comparison: aksar perfect calculation ki zaroorat nahi, bas kaunsi line behtar hai.
  • Quiet moves ko mat bhoolo: forcing line ke beech ek shaant chaal bhi hoti hai.
  • Blunder check (aakhri 10 second): "Opponent ka sabse forcing jawab kya hai?"
  • Intuition + calculation: pehle feel, phir calculation se check.
  • Training: roz 15-30 min tough puzzles bina board chhuye solve karo, poori line dimaag mein.

Calculate karo: mate in 5! (Philidor's legacy, saari chaalein forcing)

  • `Qd5+ Kh8 Nf7+ Kg8 Nh6+ Kh8 Qg8+!
  • Rxg8 Nf7#`.
  • Smothered mate: forcing moves ko end tak calculate karna seekho.

14.2

Time management

Clock bhi opponent hai

Yaad rakho
  • Classical 60+ min, rapid 10-60, blitz ≤10, bullet <3. +2 = har chaal par 2 second.
  • Opening jaldi, time critical positions mein lagao.
  • Ek chaal par total time ka 10% se zyada kam hi.
  • Time trouble mein simple, safe chaalein.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 14.2.1 Clock ka khel
  2. 14.2.2 Sawal 1: 5+3 blitz mein "+3" ka matlab?
  3. 14.2.3 Sawal 2: Sabse zyada time kahan lagana chahiye?
  4. 14.2.4 Sawal 3: Clock mein sirf 1 minute bacha, position complicated hai
  5. 14.2.5 Sawal 4: "Increment" (jaise +10 sec) kya hai?

14.2.1 Clock ka khel

  • Time controls (FIDE):
    • Classical: har player 60+ minute (jaise 90 min + 30 sec/move)
    • Rapid: 10 se 60 minute
    • Blitz: 10 minute ya kam (jaise 3+2, 5+0)
    • Bullet: 3 minute se kam (online)
  • Increment (+2): har chaal ke baad 2 second judte hain.
  • Tips:
  • Opening jaldi (jo aata hai), sabse zyada time critical positions mein (jab plan badle, ya tactics ho).
  • Ek chaal par total time ka 10% se zyada kam hi lagao.
  • Time trouble se bacho: simple, safe chaalein.
  • Opponent ke time mein bhi socho (general plans).

  • Time trouble mein simple khelo: forcing threats rok do, trades karo, bina zaroorat complication mat banao.

14.3

Psychology aur practical play

Dimaag ko control karo

Yaad rakho
  • Haar ke baad gussa (tilt) = break lo.
  • Stronger opponent se mat daro, normal achhi chaalein.
  • Jeeti position mein relax mat ho; haarti position mein resist karo.
  • Neend, paani, fitness aur warm-up routine.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 14.3.1 Mental game
  2. 14.3.2 Sawal 1: Lagaataar 3 blitz haar gaye aur gussa aa raha hai
  3. 14.3.3 Sawal 2: Tumse 300 rating zyada opponent hai
  4. 14.3.4 Sawal 3: Tum jeet rahe ho (piece aage)
  5. 14.3.5 Sawal 4: Opponent ne achanak ek chaal chali jisse tum hairaan ho

14.3.1 Mental game

  • Tilt: ek haar ke baad gusse mein games mat khelo. Break lo.
  • Stronger opponent: darr ke draw mat khelo, normal achhi chaalein. Rating board par nahi khelti.
  • Jeeti position: relax mat ho. "The hardest game to win is a won game." Safe moves, counterplay rokna.
  • Haarti position: resist karo! Complications, traps, time pressure: comeback hote hain.
  • Draw offers: position aur tournament situation dekh kar.
  • Fitness, neend, paani: lambe games mein bahut fark padta hai.
  • Routine: game se pehle halka warm-up (puzzles), phone door.

14.3.2 Sawal 1: Lagaataar 3 blitz haar gaye aur gussa aa raha hai

14.4

Apne games analyse karo

Sabse tez improvement

Yaad rakho
  • Pehle khud analyse karo, phir engine.
  • Critical moments dhundo, aur engine ki chaal kyun best hai samjho.
  • Galtiyon ki category banao (tactic, blunder, time, plan, endgame) aur wahi train karo.

14.4.1 Analysis ka sahi tareeka

  • Game ke baad pehle khud analyse karo (bina engine): kahan socha, kya miss kiya. Apne thoughts likho.
  • Critical moments dhundo: jahan eval bada badla ya plan badla.
  • Opening: kahan theory se bahar aaye? Sahi chaal note karo.
  • Phir engine se check karo. Sirf "best move" mat dekho: kyun best hai, samjho.
  • Galtiyon ko category mein daalo: tactic miss, blunder, time, plan, endgame technique. Jo zyada ho, wahi train karo.
  • Haare games sabse zyada sikhate hain.
  • Is app ke Trainer mein Stockfish coach tumhare games ki galtiyan samjhata hai.
  • Aur yahan ka 🤖 AI coach se bhi pooch sakte ho.

14.5

Improve aur jeetne ke tips

Self analysis, thoda strong opponent, feedback, tactical monster, golden goose, opening stats, Art of War

Yaad rakho
  • Apne games khud analyse karo (engine se pehle).
  • Thoda strong opponents se khelo: sabse zyada seekhoge.
  • Alag-alag tareeke try karo: OTB, online, rapid, classical, puzzles, books, coach.
  • Bahar ke feedback (engine eval, logon ki raay) par andhaa bharosa mat karo: samjho kyun.
  • Priority: "tactical monster" bano. Tactics = undo button: galti hui to tactics se wapsi.
  • Golden goose: sirf jeet (ande) mat dekho, apna improvement (hans) bachao. Kamzor opponents ko pita kar khush mat ho.
  • Jeet ke liye: piece activity, king attack, lagaataar pressure, opening aur middlegame ka link.
  • Opening wahi khelo jisme tumhare stats achhe (Chess for Tigers). Kasparov ki nakal mat karo bina samjhe.
  • Art of War: khud ko, opponent ko aur maidan (time control, situation) ko jaano.

14.5.1 Improve kaise karein

  • Self analysis: har game ke baad pehle khud analyse karo, apne thoughts likho, phir engine.
  • Thoda strong opponents: unse haar kar sabse zyada seekhoge.
  • Experience ke alag tareeke: OTB tournaments, online, rapid/classical, puzzles, books, coach. Dekho kya kaam karta hai.
  • Bahar ke feedback se savdhaan: engine ka number ya kisi ki raay bina samjhe mat maano.
  • Knowledge ki priority: "tactical monster" bano. Teichmann: "chess 99% tactics hai." Tactics har phase mein hain aur tumhara undo button hain.

14.5.4 Jeetne ke tips

  • Golden goose ka khayal: sirf jeet (ande) ke peeche mat bhaago, apna improvement (hans) zyada keemti.
  • Piece activity: Fischer ki tarah pieces hamesha active; nahi to counterplay.
  • King attack aur pressure: lagaataar dabaav se opponent galti karta hai.
  • Opening-middlegame link: opening ke plans middlegame tak samjho.
  • Opening choice: apne games ke stats dekho (book "Chess for Tigers"), jisme jeet zyada woh khelo. Kasparov mat bano: GM ki chaalein bina samjhe copy mat karo.
  • Context aur Art of War: khud ko, opponent ko aur maidan (time control, zaroori result, thakaan) jaano. "Pehle khud ko haar se bachao, phir attack."

14.6

Calculation 4: Legendary 6-8 chaal

Lambi forcing lines, ginti, critical moment, roz ka GM plan

Yaad rakho
  • 6-8 chaal ki line lagbhag hamesha forcing hoti hai: checks, captures, promotion race.
  • Pawn race mein chaalein gino: kaun pehle queen banta hai, aur kya queen banate hi check hai?
  • Critical moment par ruko: game ka faisla hone wala ho to zyada time do.
  • Line ke beech mein opponent ki "chupi" chaal (quiet defence, zwischenzug) dhundo.
  • Roz: 10 Gym puzzles apne step par + 3 review + 1 lambi line board chhupa ke.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 14.6.1 Legendary calculation kya hai
  2. 14.6.2 Critical moment aur time
  3. 14.6.3 Sawal 1: Lambi (6+ chaal) calculation kab karni chahiye?
  4. 14.6.4 Abhyaas: Pawn race
  5. 14.6.5 Abhyaas: Legendary
  6. 14.6.6 GM banne ka roz ka plan

14.6.1 Legendary calculation kya hai

  • 6-8 chaal ki calculation sirf GM ka jaadu nahi.
  • Lambi lines aksar forcing hoti hain: lagaataar checks, captures ya pawn race.
  • Har chaal par opponent ke 1-2 jawab hote hain, isliye ped patla rehta hai.
  • Teen auzaar:
    • Ginti (counting): pawn race mein dono taraf ki chaalein gino.
    • Checkpoints: har 2 chaal par material, kings aur latke pieces gino.
    • Chupi chaal: line ke beech opponent ka quiet defence ya zwischenzug (beech ki chaal). Har checkpoint par pucho: "kya opponent ke paas check ke alawa koi zabardast chaal hai?"

14.6.2 Critical moment aur time

  • Har chaal par 8 chaal calculate karna galat hai.
  • Critical moment pehchano:
    • Bade trades ya sacrifice ka faisla
    • Endgame mein jaane ka faisla
    • Opponent ki forcing chaalein shuru hone wali hon
  • Aise moment par 5-10 minute lagao, aur baaki chaalein principles se jaldi khelo.
  • Line ki shuruaat mein hi skip rules lagao, warna time khatam ho jaata hai.

14.6.3 Sawal 1: Lambi (6+ chaal) calculation kab karni chahiye?

Lambi (6+ chaal) calculation kab karni chahiye?

Jawab

✓ Forcing sequence ya critical moment par

  • Lambi lines tabhi bharosemand hain jab forcing ho.
  • Quiet chaalon par itna gehra sochna time barbaad karta hai.

14.6.4 Abhyaas: Pawn race

Pawn race: 6 chaal. Ginti karo: kiska pawn pehle pahunchta hai?

Jawab dekho

1. Ke5 h4 2. f6 Kg6 3. Ke6 h3 4. f7 Kg7 5. Ke7 h2 6. f8=Q+

  • Ke5! King pawn ke saath.
  • Ginti: White ka f-pawn check ke saath queen banta hai, Black ka h-pawn ek chaal peeche reh jaata hai.
  • Lichess puzzle [BOADm] · rating 982

14.6.5 Abhyaas: Legendary

Legendary: 6 chaal mein mate. Sacrifice, sacrifice, phir mate. Har check par opponent ka forced jawab socho.

Jawab dekho

1. Rh8+ Kxh8 2. Rh1+ Kg8 3. Rh8+ Kxh8 4. Qh1+ Rh2 5. Qxh2+ Kg8 6. Qh7#

  • `Rh8+!
  • Kxh8 Rh1+ Kg8 Rh8+!
  • Kxh8 Qh1+ Rh2 Qxh2+ Kg8 Qh7#`: do rooks dekar h-file khuli, phir queen ka mate.
  • Har chaal check thi, isliye 6 chaal bhi calculate ho saki.
  • Lichess puzzle [5DUpz] · rating 1113

14.6.6 GM banne ka roz ka plan

  • 10-15 Gym puzzles apne current step par (pehle sahi, phir tez).
  • 3 review puzzles (purani galtiyan).
  • 1 lambi line board chhupa ke (Andhe ya Poori line step).
  • Har haftey ek slow game (15+10 ya lamba): har critical moment par routine lagao, game ke baad check karo ki kahan line galat thi.
  • Ladder ke 47 steps poore hone mein mahine lagenge.
  • Yahi asli GM training hai: chhote steps, roz, bina chhode.

15.1.1 Opera Game: Morphy vs Duke & Count (1858)

  • Sabse famous game: development, open lines aur sacrifices ka perfect example.

1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 d6 3. d4 Bg4 4. dxe5 Bxf3 5. Qxf3 dxe5 6. Bc4 Nf6 7. Qb3 Qe7 8. Nc3 c6 9. Bg5 b5 10. Nxb5 cxb5 11. Bxb5+ Nbd7 12. O-O-O Rd8 13. Rxd7 Rxd7 14. Rd1 Qe6 15. Bxd7+ Nxd7 16. Qb8+ Nxb8 17. Rd8#

  • 3...Bg4?! bishop jaldi trade hoga.
  • 5.Qxf3 White ki queen active, development aage.
  • 7.Qb3! f7 aur b7 dono par attack.
  • 9.Bg5 ek aur piece develop. Black ke pieces bandh rahe hain.
  • 10.Nxb5! sacrifice: lines kholo!
  • 12.O-O-O rook seedha d-file par.
  • 13.Rxd7! aur sacrifice.
  • 15.Bxd7+
  • 16.Qb8+!! Queen sacrifice!
  • 17.Rd8# Mate! Seekh: development + open lines = attack.

15.1.2 Chess ki kahani

  • Chess ka janam Bharat mein hua: 6th century ka Chaturanga (4 ang: haathi, ghoda, rath, paidal).
  • Persia mein Shatranj, phir Europe. ~1475 mein Spain mein modern queen aur bishop ki chaal.
  • Pehle official World Champion: Wilhelm Steinitz (1886).
  • Legends: Capablanca, Alekhine, Botvinnik, Tal, Bobby Fischer, Karpov, Garry Kasparov, Magnus Carlsen.
  • Bharat ke heroes: Viswanathan Anand (5 baar World Champion), aur D. Gukesh jo 2024 mein sabse kam umar ke World Champion bane. Praggnanandhaa, Arjun Erigaisi, Koneru Humpy, Divya Deshmukh bhi top par.
  • Chess960 (Freestyle): pieces ki starting position random, theory kam, samajh zyada.

Yaad rakho

  • Morphy: Opera Game (1858): development aur open lines.

15.2.1 Immortal Game: Anderssen vs Kieseritzky (1851)

  • Romantic daur ka sabse famous game: White ne dono rooks, ek bishop aur queen de diye!

1. e4 e5 2. f4 exf4 3. Bc4 Qh4+ 4. Kf1 b5 5. Bxb5 Nf6 6. Nf3 Qh6 7. d3 Nh5 8. Nh4 Qg5 9. Nf5 c6 10. g4 Nf6 11. Rg1 cxb5 12. h4 Qg6 13. h5 Qg5 14. Qf3 Ng8 15. Bxf4 Qf6 16. Nc3 Bc5 17. Nd5 Qxb2 18. Bd6 Bxg1 19. e5 Qxa1+ 20. Ke2 Na6 21. Nxg7+ Kd8 22. Qf6+ Nxf6 23. Be7#

  • 2.f4 King's Gambit.
  • 17.Nd5! material ki parwah nahi.
  • 18.Bd6!! rook g1 bhi de diya.
  • 19.e5! queen ko a1 tak jaane do.
  • 21.Nxg7+
  • 22.Qf6+!! queen bhi!
  • 23.Be7# Teen minor pieces ka mate.

15.2.2 Pehle champions

  • Wilhelm Steinitz (1886-1894): pehle official World Champion. Positional chess ke principles diye (weak squares, bishop pair, defense).
  • Emanuel Lasker (1894-1921): 27 saal champion. Psychology aur practical chess. Famous: Lasker vs Bauer (1889): Bxh7+ aur Bxg7 do bishops ka sacrifice.
  • Jose Raul Capablanca (1921-1927): simple, saaf, endgame ka jaadugar. "Endgame pehle padho."
  • Alexander Alekhine (1927-1935, 1937-1946): bhayankar attack aur gehri combinations. Champion rehte hue hi guzre.
  • Max Euwe (1935-1937): maths teacher, amateur jo Alekhine ko hara kar champion bane; baad mein FIDE president.

15.2.3 Lasker vs Bauer (1889): do bishops ka sacrifice

  • Pehli baar famous "double bishop sacrifice".

1. f4 d5 2. e3 Nf6 3. b3 e6 4. Bb2 Be7 5. Bd3 b6 6. Nc3 Bb7 7. Nf3 Nbd7 8. O-O O-O 9. Ne2 c5 10. Ng3 Qc7 11. Ne5 Nxe5 12. Bxe5 Qc6 13. Qe2 a6 14. Nh5 Nxh5 15. Bxh7+ Kxh7 16. Qxh5+ Kg8 17. Bxg7 Kxg7 18. Qg4+ Kh7 19. Rf3

  • 15.Bxh7+! pehla bishop.
  • 16.Qxh5+
  • 17.Bxg7!! doosra bishop.
  • 18.Qg4+
  • 19.Rf3 rook h-file par aayega: queen bachane ke liye Black ko queen deni padegi.

15.4

The Queen's Gambit series se sabak (1)

Episode 1-4: pitfalls, passed pawn, exchanges, doubled pawns

Yaad rakho
  • Ep 1: Shaibel ka pehla sabak: opening pitfalls (jaldi queen, lalach); passed pawn breakthrough; ek sundar mate.
  • Ep 2: Exchanges ki samajh (Beth vs Cooke), endgame mein tactics (Townes vs Beth), Beltik game (Nezhmetdinov-Kasparian 1955 par based).
  • Ep 3: Doubled pawns ka upside (Caro-Kann, Cincinnati); Benny doubled pawns allow karke Beth ko harata hai.
  • Ep 4: Fischer-Larsen game; jeet rahe ho to pieces trade (Anand-Kasparov); Bernstein-Capablanca back-row mate; Borgov vs Beth (Stein ka game).

15.7

Elo badhane ka training plan

Roz kya karein

Yaad rakho
  • 0-1000: rules, hanging pieces, basic mates. 1000-1400: tactics. 1400-1800: calculation + endgames. 1800+: strategy.
  • Roz 45-60 min: puzzles, lesson, ek slow game, analysis.
  • Roz thoda, lagaataar: 3 mahine ki consistency = bada jump.
  • Weak link in chain: tumhari sabse kamzor kadi (opening/middlegame/endgame) pehle mazboot karo.
  • Concentric circles badhaate raho: principles, phir processes/patterns, phir details aur exceptions.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 15.7.1 Rating ke hisaab se focus
  2. 15.7.2 Roz ka routine (45-60 min)
  3. 15.7.3 Sawal 1: 1200 rating par sabse zyada fayda kisse?
  4. 15.7.4 Sawal 2: Roz ke routine mein slow game (15+10) kyun?
  5. 15.7.5 Sawal 3: 0-1000 rating par sabse zyada fayda kisse?
  6. 15.7.6 Course ka antim sandesh: weak link in chain
  7. 15.7.7 Sawal 4: Improvement ka "weak link in chain" model kya kehta hai?

15.7.1 Rating ke hisaab se focus

  • 0-1000: rules pakke, hanging pieces na dena, basic mates (Level 1-4). Roz 20 easy puzzles.
  • 1000-1400: tactics aur mate patterns (Level 5-7). Opening principles. 15+10 rapid games.
  • 1400-1800: calculation, basic endgames (Level 12-13), ek repertoire, apne games analyse.
  • 1800-2200: strategy (Level 8-9), master games, gehri endgame theory, classical games.
  • 2200+: coach, deep opening prep, tournaments, physical aur mental training.

15.7.2 Roz ka routine (45-60 min)

  • 15 min: puzzles (is app ka Puzzles tab + review)
  • 15 min: ek lesson ya endgame study
  • 20 min: ek slow game (15+10 ya zyada), blitz kam
  • 10 min: us game ka analysis
  • Hafte mein ek baar: ek master game dhyan se
  • Books (jab taiyaar ho): "Logical Chess: Move by Move" (Chernev), "Silman's Complete Endgame Course", "How to Reassess Your Chess" (Silman), "My System" (Nimzowitsch), "Dvoretsky's Endgame Manual" (advanced).
  • Sabse badi baat: roz thoda, lagaataar. 3 mahine ki consistency = bada jump.

15.7.3 Sawal 1: 1200 rating par sabse zyada fayda kisse?

1200 rating par sabse zyada fayda kisse?

Jawab

✓ Roz tactics puzzles + slow games + analysis

15.7.4 Sawal 2: Roz ke routine mein slow game (15+10) kyun?

Roz ke routine mein slow game (15+10) kyun?

Jawab

✓ Sochne aur calculation ka abhyaas hota hai

  • Slow game mein process (CCT, calculation) lagane ka time milta hai.
  • Blitz mein sirf intuition.

15.7.5 Sawal 3: 0-1000 rating par sabse zyada fayda kisse?

0-1000 rating par sabse zyada fayda kisse?

Jawab

✓ Hanging pieces na dena aur basic mates

  • Shuruaat mein games pieces latakne aur mates miss karne se haare jaate hain.

15.7.6 Course ka antim sandesh: weak link in chain

  • Tumhari chess ek chain jaisi hai: sabse kamzor kadi jitni strong, utne tum.
  • Apne games se pata karo kamzori kahan hai (opening, tactics, endgame, time) aur pehle wahi sudhaaro.
  • Aur concentric circles badhaate raho: principles → processes/patterns → details/exceptions, teeno phases mein.

15.7.7 Sawal 4: Improvement ka "weak link in chain" model kya kehta hai?

Improvement ka "weak link in chain" model kya kehta hai?

Jawab

✓ Sabse kamzor hissa pehle mazboot karo

  • Chain sabse kamzor kadi se toot-ti hai.

Level 16

Openings 3: advanced trees, structures aur plans

12-15+ chaal ke trees, move orders, transpositions, har opening ka middlegame plan

  • Ab har opening ko gehraai se: lambi lines, move order ki chaalaakiyan, aur opening se aane wale pawn structures ke plans.
  • Yahan structures aur plans wale lessons kaam aayenge.
16.1

Indian structures: KID chain, Benoni, Hedgehog

Band aur asymmetric centers ke plans

Yaad rakho
  • KID chain d5-e4 vs d6-e5: White c5 (queenside), Black ...f5 (kingside). Jad par chot.
  • Benoni: White e5 break + f4; Black ...b5, ...c4, knight e5/c5.
  • Hedgehog (a6-b6-d6-e6): Black kam jagah par flexible; breaks ...b5 ya ...d5.
  • Maroczy jaisa bind English/Sicilian dono mein: pieces trade karke breaks.
  • Structure batata hai: kahan attack, kahan defence.

16.3

Italian (advanced): tree, IQP aur ...d5 break

Giuoco Pianissimo 15+ chaal, 5.d4 se isolated pawn, Black ka equalizer

Yaad rakho
  • Pianissimo mein Black ka sabse achha equalizer: sahi waqt par ...d5 break.
  • 5.d4 exd4 6.cxd4 Bb4+ 7.Bd2 Bxd2+ 8.Nbxd2 d5!: White ko isolated d4 pawn (IQP).
  • IQP wala: pieces active, kingside attack, d5 push. Doosra: d5 square block karo, pieces trade karo.
  • Bishop trade ...Be6 se: White Bxe6 Rxe6 ya bishop c2 rakhe. Bb3/a4 bishop ki jagah.
  • Move order: 4.d3 (Two Knights) aur 4.c3 Nf6 5.d3 (Giuoco) aksar same position.

  • Black: d5 square par knight rakho (blockade), pieces trade karo.
  • Endgame mein d4 pawn kamzor.
  • Yeh plan Queen's Gambit, Caro-Kann Panov aur Sicilian Alapin mein bhi aata hai: ek structure, kai openings.

16.4

Ruy Lopez (advanced): Zaitsev, anti-Marshall, Berlin plans

Band center ke plans, move order se Marshall se bachna, Berlin endgame

Yaad rakho
  • Closed Ruy mein d5 aaya to center band: White kingside (Nf1-g3, Nh2-g4), Black queenside (...c4, ...b4) ya ...f5.
  • Zaitsev: ...Bb7, ...Re8, ...Bf8: e4 par dabaav.
  • Anti-Marshall: 8.h3/8.a4/8.d3 (8.c3 ki jagah). Move order se opponent ka hathiyaar band.
  • Berlin endgame: White ka kingside majority (e5), Black ke 2 bishops. Black ...h5, ...Rh6.
  • Open center (exd4 cxd4): pieces ki ladai. Band center: pawn breaks ki ladai.

16.4.1 Zaitsev: Karpov-Kasparov ka battle

  • Black ka sabse ambitious Closed Ruy. 17 chaal tak.

  • 9...Bb7 Zaitsev: e4 par dabaav.
  • 16.d5 Center band.
  • 17.Ra3 Rook teesri rank se kingside par.

16.4.2 Sawal 1: d5 ke baad center band hai

d5 ke baad center band hai. Plans kahan banenge?

Jawab

✓ Flanks par: pawn breaks (...c4, ...f5, a4, Nf1-g3)

  • Band center = flanks ki ladai.
  • Jahan tumhare pawns "point" karte hain, wahan khelo.

16.4.3 Anti-Marshall: 8.h3

  • Marshall se bachna hai?

16.7

QGD structures: Carlsbad, IQP, hanging pawns

Queen's Gambit ke 3 structures aur unke plans

Yaad rakho
  • Carlsbad: White minority attack (Rb1, b4-b5) ya center f3+e4. Black kingside (...Ne4, ...f5, ...Rh6).
  • IQP (Tarrasch, QGA, Semi-Tarrasch): IQP wala activity, doosra blockade + trades.
  • Hanging pawns (c5+d5): mazboot par target. Plan: ...d4 ya ...c4 push sahi waqt par.
  • Move order: cxd5 jaldi = Exchange (Carlsbad). Nf3 pehle = ...Bb4 (Ragozin) ya ...dxc4 options.
  • Ek structure kai openings mein: Caro Exchange = ulta Carlsbad.

16.12

Scandinavian aur Pirc (advanced plans)

Scandi structure, Pirc ...e5 aur ...c5 breaks

Yaad rakho
  • Scandi: Black ka structure c6-e6 (Caro jaisa), White ka d4. Black ...Nbd7, ...Be7, castle; break ...c5.
  • White Scandi plan: d5 push ya kingside Ne5, Qe2, O-O-O.
  • Pirc: Black ...e5 (center) ya ...c6-b5 (queenside). White f4-e5 ya Bh6 + h4-h5.
  • Hypermodern defences: center White ko do, phir breaks se chot.
  • Agar White ne zyada aage badha (overextend), to piece pressure se pawns jeeto.

16.13

Sicilian structures: Scheveningen, ...e5, Maroczy

Teen Sicilian structures aur unke plans

Yaad rakho
  • Scheveningen (...e6 + ...d6): "small center". Black ke breaks ...d5 aur ...b5. White f4, g4-g5 ya e5.
  • ...e5 structure (Najdorf, Sveshnikov): d5 hole, par Black ko center aur ...d5/...f5 breaks.
  • Maroczy Bind (c4 + e4): White ki jagah. Black trade kare, ...b5/...d5/...f5 break dhundhe.
  • Sicilian mein ...d5 break aksar Black ka "equalizer": agar safe ho, khelo.
  • White ka Nd5 sacrifice/occupation, aur e5 push: Sicilian ke do bade hathiyaar.

16.14

Sicilian move orders aur transpositions

2...d6 / 2...Nc6 / 2...e6 ka chunav, anti-Sicilian se bachna, Najdorf ke move orders

Yaad rakho
  • 2...d6 Najdorf/Dragon ki taraf, par 3.Bb5+ (Moscow) allow karta hai.
  • 2...Nc6 Sveshnikov/Classical/Accelerated ki taraf, par 3.Bb5 (Rossolimo).
  • 2...e6 Taimanov/Kan/Scheveningen, par 3.d3 (KIA) ya 3.c3.
  • Scheveningen aksar Najdorf se aata hai (5...a6 6.Be2 e6): transposition.
  • White ka 6.h3 ya 6.Be3 Najdorf mein move order choice: Black ko kaunsa setup dena hai.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 16.14.1 Black ka 2nd move: ek chunav, ek keemat
  2. 16.14.2 Sawal 1: Tumhe Rossolimo (3.Bb5 after 2...Nc6) pasand nahi
  3. 16.14.3 Najdorf se Scheveningen (transposition)
  4. 16.14.4 Taimanov se Scheveningen
  5. 16.14.5 Sawal 2: Is position tak kitne move orders se pahunch sakte hain?
  6. 16.14.6 Abhyaas: White ne 6.h3 (Adams Attack) khela

16.14.1 Black ka 2nd move: ek chunav, ek keemat

  • Black ki doosri chaal tay karti hai ki kaunsa anti-Sicilian aa sakta hai:
    • 2...d6: Najdorf, Dragon, Scheveningen. White ke paas Moscow 3.Bb5+.
    • 2...Nc6: Sveshnikov, Classical, Accelerated Dragon, Taimanov. White ke paas Rossolimo 3.Bb5.
    • 2...e6: Taimanov, Kan, Scheveningen. White ke paas 3.d3 (KIA setup) ya 3.c3.
  • Repertoire banate waqt yeh dekho ki kaunse anti-Sicilian tumhe pasand nahi.

16.14.2 Sawal 1: Tumhe Rossolimo (3.Bb5 after 2...Nc6) pasand nahi

Tumhe Rossolimo (3.Bb5 after 2...Nc6) pasand nahi. Kaunsa 2nd move behtar?

Jawab

✓ 2...d6 ya 2...e6

  • 2...d6/2...e6 ke baad 3.Bb5 Rossolimo nahi hota (Moscow ya kuch aur aata hai).

16.15

Anti-Sicilians (advanced): Alapin IQP, Rossolimo structures, Smith-Morra defence

Gehri lines aur unke plans

Yaad rakho
  • Alapin 2...d5 aksar IQP deta hai: Black blockade + trades, White activity.
  • Rossolimo ...g6 + Bxc6 dxc6: Black ke 2 bishops; White d3, h3, Be3, Qd2, Bh6 se trade.
  • Smith-Morra: Black ka solid setup ...Nc6, ...e6, ...d6, ...a6, ...Nge7/...Nf6, ...Be7, castle. ...Qc7 ke saath Siberian ka dhyan.
  • Smith-Morra decline 3...d5 ya 3...Nf6: aaram se barabar.
  • Grand Prix f4 ke khilaaf ...d5 break sabse seedha.

Level 18

Openings 5: apna repertoire (mastery)

Repertoire chuno, poora tree drill karo, apni games se update karo, opponent ke liye taiyaari

  • Aakhri seedhi: ab tum har opening jaante ho.
  • Yahan apna repertoire pakka karo, use roz drill karo, aur apni games se usse update karte raho.
  • Yahi masters ka tareeka hai.
18.1

Apna repertoire chuno

Style ke hisaab se 3 tayyar repertoires, aur coverage checklist

Yaad rakho
  • Repertoire = har mumkin jawab ke liye ek tayyar line. Kam par gehra, zyada par kachcha nahi.
  • Coverage: White 1.e4 ke liye ...e5, ...c5, ...e6, ...c6, ...d5, ...d6/...g6, ...Nf6 sab ka jawab.
  • Black ke liye: 1.e4, 1.d4, 1.c4, 1.Nf3 aur systems (London, KIA) sab ka jawab.
  • Style: tactical = Sicilian/KID/gambits, positional = Caro/QGD/Catalan, kam theory = systems.
  • Har 3 mahine repertoire file dekho: kahan games haare, kahan book jaldi khatam hua.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 18.1.1 Repertoire ka matlab
  2. 18.1.2 3 tayyar repertoires (is course ki lines se)
  3. 18.1.3 Sawal 1: Tumhe tactics aur attack pasand hai
  4. 18.1.4 Sawal 2: White 1.e4 repertoire mein kaunsa jawab bhool jaate hain log aksar?
  5. 18.1.5 Sawal 3: Repertoire ka sabse achha size?

18.1.1 Repertoire ka matlab

  • Ek repertoire tumhari opening "file" hai: har position mein tum kya khelte ho.
  • White: ek pehli chaal (1.e4 ya 1.d4) aur har Black jawab ke liye ek line.
  • Black vs 1.e4: ek defence (jaise 1...e5 ya Caro-Kann).
  • Black vs 1.d4: ek defence (jaise QGD ya Nimzo/KID).
  • Black vs baaki (1.c4, 1.Nf3, London, KIA): ek-ek plan.
  • Gehraai level ke hisaab se: 1500 par 8-10 chaal kaafi, 2000+ par 15+ aur middlegame plans.

18.1.2 3 tayyar repertoires (is course ki lines se)

  • Solid (positional): White 1.d4 + Queen's Gambit (QGD Exchange plans), London backup.
  • Black: Caro-Kann vs 1.e4, QGD/Slav vs 1.d4.
  • Aggressive (tactical): White 1.e4 + Open Sicilian (English Attack), Italian/Evans.
  • Black: Najdorf/Dragon vs 1.e4, KID vs 1.d4.
  • Kam theory (practical): White London/KIA system.
  • Black: 1...e5 (Petrov/Italian solid) vs 1.e4, ...d5 + ...c5/...Qb6 vs systems, QGD vs 1.d4.
  • Jo style tumhe pasand ho, wahi chuno: tumhari games mein woh positions baar-baar aayengi.

18.1.3 Sawal 1: Tumhe tactics aur attack pasand hai

Tumhe tactics aur attack pasand hai. Black vs 1.e4 ke liye sabse fit?

Jawab

✓ Sicilian Najdorf ya Dragon

  • Sicilian asymmetric aur sharp: dono taraf jeet ke chances.

18.1.4 Sawal 2: White 1.e4 repertoire mein kaunsa jawab bhool jaate hain log aksar?

White 1.e4 repertoire mein kaunsa jawab bhool jaate hain log aksar?

Jawab

✓ 1...Nf6 (Alekhine) aur 1...d6 (Pirc)

  • Kam common defences bhi aate hain.
  • Unke liye ek simple plan (bada center, develop) tayyar rakho.

18.1.5 Sawal 3: Repertoire ka sabse achha size?

Repertoire ka sabse achha size?

Jawab

✓ Kam openings, par unke plans aur structures gehraai se

  • Gehraai > chaudai.
  • Structure aur plans jaanoge to theory khatam hone ke baad bhi sahi khel paoge.

18.4

Apni games se repertoire update

Book kahan khatam hua, kisne naya khela, aur review cards: Road ka "Opening check"

Yaad rakho
  • Har game ke baad: opening book kahan khatam hua? Pehle kisne chhoda?
  • Agar tumne chhoda: kya woh chaal achhi thi? Nahi to sahi line repertoire mein jodo.
  • Agar opponent ne chhoda: uska best jawab dhundo (engine game ke BAAD) aur yaad karo.
  • Road to 3000 > My Games > Opening check: yeh sab apne aap karta hai aur review cards banata hai.
  • Har mahine repertoire report: kis opening mein score kharab, kahan book jaldi khatam.
Is lesson ke topics
  1. 18.4.1 Masters ka workflow
  2. 18.4.2 Sawal 1: Game mein opponent ne move 6 par book chhod di (naya khela)
  3. 18.4.3 Abhyaas: Tumhari game
  4. 18.4.4 Abhyaas: Tumhari game

18.4.1 Masters ka workflow

  • 1.
  • Game khelo. Opening mein engine nahi!
  • 2.
  • Game ke baad: dekho book kahan khatam hua aur kisne pehle naya khela.
  • 3.
  • Engine se check: woh chaal achhi thi ya nahi, aur best kya tha.
  • 4.
  • Repertoire update: sahi line apni file mein jodo, aur use drill karo (spaced review).
  • 5.
  • Har mahine report: kis opening mein haar zyada, kahan galtiyan.
  • Is app mein: Road to 3000 > My Games > Opening check.
  • Woh tumhari Lichess games scan karta hai, har game mein book ka end aur engine ki best chaal dikhata hai, aur galat chaalon ke review cards banata hai jo Course aur Road dono ke review mein aate hain.

18.4.2 Sawal 1: Game mein opponent ne move 6 par book chhod di (naya khela)

Game mein opponent ne move 6 par book chhod di (naya khela). Tum kya karoge game ke baad?

Jawab

✓ Engine se uska best jawab dekho aur apne repertoire mein jodo

  • Agli baar wahi position aaye to tayyar raho.
  • Yahi repertoire update hai.

18.4.3 Abhyaas: Tumhari game

Tumhari game: Caro Advance mein opponent ne 4.g4?! khela (book se bahar). Best jawab?

Jawab dekho

1… Be4

Ye bhi sahi: Bd7

  • 4...Be4! bishop active rehta hai aur f3 ke baad ...Bg6.
  • Yeh line repertoire mein jodo.

18.4.4 Abhyaas: Tumhari game

Tumhari game: Ruy Lopez mein opponent ne 3...Nd4 (Bird) khela. Seedha aur achha jawab?

Jawab dekho

1. Nxd4

  • 4.Nxd4 exd4 5.O-O aur d3, Re1: White ka development aage.
  • Repertoire mein jodo.

18.4.5 Abhyaas: Tumhari game (Black)

Tumhari game (Black): QGD mein White ne 4.e4 (Marshall Gambit) khela. Solid jawab?

Jawab dekho

1… dxe4

Ye bhi sahi: Bb4

  • 4...dxe4 5.Nxe4 Bb4+ main line.
  • Gambit mein bhi principles: develop, pawn tab tak rakho jab tak development na ruke.

18.4.6 Sawal 2: Repertoire report mein "Book tak

Repertoire report mein "Book tak: 4 chaal" aur "Galti: 3" ek opening mein. Matlab?

Jawab

✓ Us opening ki theory kam aati hai: uska ladder lesson dobara karo

  • Jaldi book khatam + galtiyan = kamzor area.
  • Seedha usi par kaam karo.

18.5

Opponent ke liye taiyaari aur final exam

Tournament prep ka tareeka, phir poori ladder ka mixed exam

Yaad rakho
  • Prep: opponent ki games (Lichess) se uski openings dekho, apne repertoire mein se sabse achha jawab chuno.
  • Surprise se pehle apni comfort: aisi line chuno jiske plans tum jaante ho.
  • Game se pehle 10 minute: chuni hui line 2 baar drill karo, typical plans yaad karo.
  • Novelty mile to ghabrao mat: principles aur structure ke plans.
  • Mastery = theory + plans + update ka cycle, roz.

18.5.1 Tournament prep: 4 kadam

  • 1.
  • Opponent ki games (Lichess profile, "Opening explorer" mein uska naam): woh White aur Black mein kya khelta hai?
  • 2.
  • Apne repertoire se line chuno: uski favourite line ke khilaaf tumhara best jawab.
  • 3.
  • Gehraai: us line ke plans aur 2-3 sidelines dekho.
  • 4.
  • Drill: game se pehle line 2 baar khud khelo.
  • Yaad rakho: comfort zone wali line > ajeeb surprise jiske plans nahi pata.

Opponent hamesha London khelta hai. Tumhara prep?

  • Plan ready = confidence.
